![Witcher equipment sets](images/visual-witcher-equipment.png)

### Example starter outfit

A steel witcher sword with the four basic Witcher armor pieces is one craftable starting outfit, not the official default or a required school. The model shows appearance and the held sword only. School armor and the medallion are separate choices.

### Readiness & first fight

Witchers run on two attributes, Sign intensity and Adrenaline gain. Steel swords are the physical choice against human foes, silver swords carry the sign build and are strong against undead, and sign intensity raises the damage of every sign. Wolven, Feline, Griffin and Ursine are the school families, each with ranks from base up to grandmaster, and a school medallion adds its own effect when it is paired with the matching armor. A good first fight is a sign placed first and two sword hits after it, with the sign landing because you read the mob's approach.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first sword | Iron ingots to blast into steel, the sword recipe, and the basic Witcher armor recipe. | Craft the iron witcher sword. Silver is worth carrying once you meet undead, and silver ore sits in the cave depths the publisher lists. |
| Early midgame: first book | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves, the fencing book or the sign manual, and its learning cost. | Bind one book first. Take the sign manual if you already fight at range, the fencing book if you close in. |
| Midgame: school set | One school armor family at base rank, and the matching school medallion. | Pick the school whose attribute matches your weapon. Upgrade that family step by step rather than starting a second. |
| Late game: grandmaster | The materials each rank recipe asks for up to grandmaster, plus the medallion. | Pair grandmaster armor with its medallion. Named swords such as Aerondight come from end game loot, not from a recipe. |

![猎魔人装备套装](images/visual-witcher-equipment.png)

### 入门装备

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="witcher_rpg:iron_witcher_sword" /></ItemGrid>

### 入门配装示例

钢制猎魔人剑搭配四件基础猎魔人护甲，是一种可合成的入门配装，不是官方默认，也不是必须选择的学派。模型只展示外观与手持剑。学派护甲与勋章是另外的选择。

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

猎魔人依靠两项属性，法印强度与肾上腺素增益。钢剑是对付类人敌人的物理选择，银剑承载法印构筑并对亡灵更强，法印强度会提高所有法印的伤害。狼、猫、狮鹫与熊是学派家族，每套都有从基础到大宗师的多级形态，学派勋章与同系护甲搭配时会提供自己的效果。一次成功的首战，是先放一个法印，再接两下剑击，而法印之所以命中，是因为你先读出了怪物的靠近方式。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次持剑 | 铁锭经高炉烧成钢、剑的配方，以及基础猎魔人护甲配方。 | 合成铁猎魔人剑。遇到亡灵后值得随身带一把银剑，银矿位于发布说明列出的洞穴深度。 |
| 中期起步：第一本法术书 | 周围有书架的法术绑定台、剑术书或法印手册，以及学习费用。 | 先绑定一本。习惯远程作战就取法印手册，习惯贴身就取剑术书。 |
| 中期：学派套装 | 一个学派的基础护甲，以及同系勋章。 | 选择属性与武器相符的学派。逐级升级同一家族，而不是另起一套。 |
| 后期：大宗师 | 各等级配方所需的材料，直到大宗师，另加勋章。 | 让大宗师护甲与对应勋章搭配。湖女之剑等名剑来自末地战利品，不是配方产物。 |

## Role & first weapon

Bards use lutes and lyres for arcane attacks and support, with rapiers and harp crossbows as other weapon options.

![Bard music in combat](images/visual-bard-music.png)

### What to look for

Bard instruments name Arcane power and Healing power, so one held instrument can serve both a damage song and a support song. The Wooden Lute costs birch planks, string and a stick, which makes it the cheapest way to start. The maintained Bard documentation describes the lute as balanced between the two schools and the lyre as the healing-leaning instrument, and the item tooltip shows the actual split for the instrument you hold.

Songs attach to the instrument, not to the class. The article notes that each named instrument can carry a different song, so a second lute is a second song rather than a copy of the first. Read the song line on the tooltip before you trade or craft one.

The Entertainer Garb uses leather, wool and purple dye, which is early and needs no Nether trip. The Troubadour Garb uses rabbit hide, wool and gold, and the Netherite Troubadour Garb is its smithing upgrade. The Storyteller Garb is the later set that depends on other gear. Garb pieces trade physical protection for spell power and movement, so a Bard who expects to be hit should plan around that.

Rapiers and harp crossbows are the physical options. The Iron Rapier costs iron and leather, and the harp crossbow costs a tripwire hook, a stick and string. They need no runes, which makes them a useful fallback when the rune supply for a song runs low.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Wooden Lute, play its song at a hostile and see the effect land while the rune count falls, then play a support song near an ally and confirm the buff appears. If the song does nothing, check that the instrument is in the main hand and that the song's rune type is in your pouch.

### Readiness

These checkpoints are optional. The class works at any of them, and a player can stay where they are.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have birch planks, string and a stick for the Wooden Lute, and leather, wool and purple dye for a garb piece. | Play one song and fight one mob with a rapier or the lute swing. |
| Early midgame | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves is reachable and its cost is payable. | Bind the Bard book and equip it while holding an instrument or weapon. |
| Midgame | Gold and string are available, and rabbit hide can be collected. | Compare the Golden Lyre with the Wooden Lute, and the Troubadour Garb with the Entertainer Garb. |
| Late game | You hold a netherite upgrade smithing template and netherite ingots, or a unique instrument. | Upgrade one Troubadour Garb piece at a time and read the song line on any unique instrument before replacing a working one. |

## 定位与入门武器

吟游诗人使用鲁特琴与里拉琴进行奥术攻击与辅助，也以刺剑与竖琴弩作为其他武器选择。

![战斗中的吟游诗人](images/visual-bard-music.png)

### 值得关注的内容

吟游诗人的乐器同时提供奥术强度与治疗强度，因此一件手持乐器可以兼顾伤害歌曲与辅助歌曲。木鲁特琴的配方是白桦木板、线与木棍，是最便宜的起步方式。官方维护文档把鲁特琴描述为两种学派之间的平衡选择，把里拉琴描述为偏治疗的乐器，具体数值以你手持乐器的物品提示为准。

歌曲绑定在乐器上，而不是绑定在职业上。本页说明每件具名乐器可以带有不同的歌曲，因此第二把鲁特琴带来的是另一首歌，而不是第一首的复制品。交易或制作之前，先读提示里的歌曲行。

艺人华服用皮革、羊毛与紫色染料，早期就能做，不必进入下界。游吟诗人华服用兔子皮、羊毛与金锭，下界合金游吟诗人华服是它的锻造升级。说书人华服是更晚的套装，依赖其他装备。华服部件用物理防护换取法术强度与移动速度，因此预计会被打到的诗人要提前考虑这一点。

刺剑与竖琴弩是物理选项。铁刺剑用铁与皮革，竖琴弩用绊线钩、木棍与线。它们不消耗符文，因此在歌曲的符文不足时是有用的替代手段。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持木鲁特琴，对敌对生物演奏它的歌曲，看到效果命中、符文减少，再在盟友附近演奏辅助歌曲并确认增益出现。如果歌曲毫无反应，先确认乐器在主手，并确认歌曲所需的符文在符文袋里。

### 准备阶段

这些检查点是可选的。任何阶段都可以正常游玩，玩家也可以停在当前阶段。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有白桦木板、线与木棍做木鲁特琴，有皮革、羊毛与紫色染料做一件华服。 | 演奏一首歌曲，并用刺剑或鲁特琴挥击打一个怪物。 |
| 中期起步 | 能走到周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起费用。 | 绑定吟游诗人职业书，手持乐器或武器时装备它。 |
| 中期 | 能取得金锭与线，并收集兔子皮。 | 比较金里拉琴与木鲁特琴，以及游吟诗人华服与艺人华服。 |
| 后期 | 持有下界合金升级锻造模板与下界合金锭，或得到一件独特乐器。 | 每次升级一件游吟诗人华服部件，替换在用乐器前先读独特乐器的歌曲行。 |

## Role & first weapon

Priests use holy wands and staves for healing, beams and protection.

![Holy casting effects](images/visual-holy-casting.png)

### Example starter outfit

The Acolyte Wand with the four Priest Robe pieces is an example starter outfit, not the official default. The model shows appearance and the held wand, not an equipped spell book.

<GameScene zoom="4" interactive={true}>
  <IsometricCamera yaw="135" pitch="15" />
  <Entity id="minecraft:armor_stand" x="0.5" y="0" z="0.5" rotationY="180" data='{NoGravity:1b,Invulnerable:1b,ShowArms:1b,NoBasePlate:1b,ArmorItems:[{id:"paladins:priest_robe_feet",count:1},{id:"paladins:priest_robe_legs",count:1},{id:"paladins:priest_robe_chest",count:1},{id:"paladins:priest_robe_head",count:1}],HandItems:[{id:"paladins:acolyte_wand",count:1},{}]}' />
</GameScene>

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:acolyte_wand" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_head" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_chest" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_legs" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_feet" /></ItemGrid>

### What to look for

Healing spells scale with Healing power. The Acolyte Wand names Healing power and costs a stick and string, so the first healing cast does not wait for gold. The Holy Wand and the Holy Staff are the later steps in the same line, and the publisher recommends holy staves and wands for the Priest book.

The Priest Robe uses chain and wool, which is cheap and early. The Prior Robe uses gold and a ghast tear per piece, so it follows a Nether trip. The Netherite Prior Robe is its smithing upgrade. The publisher describes the holy equipment as boosting both spell damage and healing, so read the full tooltip rather than one line.

A Priest supports others, so the useful question is who is standing near you. Circle of Healing and Lightwell are area and self effects, which means a group fight rewards the class more than a solo duel. Penance and Holy Light are the direct options for a single target.

Runes matter more here than on a melee class because nearly every action costs ammunition. Carry the rune each spell names, keep a spare stack for an emergency heal, and check the pouch before a fight rather than during one.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Acolyte Wand, cast Flash Heal on an injured ally and watch the health bar rise while the rune count falls. Then cast Barrier on yourself before a fight and confirm the protection appears. If the heal lands but the barrier does not, compare the rune each spell names.

### Readiness

The hints below are optional. A player can stay in one stage as long as it serves them.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have a stick, string and the rune the wand spell names. | Craft the Acolyte Wand, heal one ally and cast one protection spell. |
| Early midgame | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves is reachable and its cost is payable. | Bind the Priest book and equip it with a compatible focus held. |
| Midgame | Chain, wool, gold and a ghast tear are available. | Compare the Priest Robe with the Prior Robe, and decide whether the Holy Wand or the Holy Staff fits your casting range. |
| Late game | You hold a netherite upgrade smithing template and netherite ingots. | Upgrade one Prior Robe piece at a time and keep enough runes for both healing and protection. |

## 定位与入门武器

牧师使用圣光魔杖与法杖，招式包含治疗、光束与保护。

![神圣施法效果](images/visual-holy-casting.png)

### 入门配装示例

侍僧魔杖搭配四件牧师长袍，是一种入门配装示例，不是官方默认配置。模型展示外观与手持魔杖，不表示已装备法术书。

<GameScene zoom="4" interactive={true}>
  <IsometricCamera yaw="135" pitch="15" />
  <Entity id="minecraft:armor_stand" x="0.5" y="0" z="0.5" rotationY="180" data='{NoGravity:1b,Invulnerable:1b,ShowArms:1b,NoBasePlate:1b,ArmorItems:[{id:"paladins:priest_robe_feet",count:1},{id:"paladins:priest_robe_legs",count:1},{id:"paladins:priest_robe_chest",count:1},{id:"paladins:priest_robe_head",count:1}],HandItems:[{id:"paladins:acolyte_wand",count:1},{}]}' />
</GameScene>

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:acolyte_wand" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_head" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_chest" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_legs" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:priest_robe_feet" /></ItemGrid>

### 值得关注的内容

治疗法术按治疗强度计算。侍僧魔杖提供治疗强度，配方只要木棍与线，因此第一次治疗不必等金锭。圣光魔杖与圣光法杖是同一条线上更晚的步骤，发行方也为牧师职业书推荐圣光法杖与魔杖。

牧师长袍用锁链与羊毛，成本低且在早期就能做。司铎长袍每件需要金锭与恶魂之泪，因此要等一次下界行程。下界合金司铎长袍是它的锻造升级。发行方说明圣光装备同时提升法术伤害与治疗，因此要看完整提示，而不只是一行。

牧师辅助别人，所以真正有用的问题是身边站着谁。治疗之环与光泉是范围与自身效果，团战比单挑更能发挥这个职业。苦修与圣光是针对单个目标的直接选项。

符文在这里比近战职业更重要，因为几乎每个动作都要消耗弹药。把每条法术指定的符文带在身上，为应急治疗留一组，进入战斗前检查符文袋，而不是打起来才看。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持侍僧魔杖，对受伤的盟友施放快速治疗，看生命值上升、符文减少。然后在战斗前对自己施放屏障并确认保护出现。如果治疗成功而屏障失败，就比较两条法术各自指定的符文。

### 准备阶段

下面的提示是可选的。一个阶段只要还有用，就可以一直停留。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有木棍、线，以及魔杖法术指定的符文。 | 做出侍僧魔杖，治疗一位盟友并施放一次保护法术。 |
| 中期起步 | 能走到周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起费用。 | 绑定牧师职业书，手持兼容法器时装备它。 |
| 中期 | 能取得锁链、羊毛、金锭与恶魂之泪。 | 比较牧师长袍与司铎长袍，并判断圣光魔杖或圣光法杖更贴合你的施法距离。 |
| 后期 | 持有下界合金升级锻造模板与下界合金锭。 | 每次升级一件司铎长袍部件，并为治疗与保护都留足符文。 |

## Role & first weapon

Paladins combine close combat and healing-school support, using maces, hammers, claymores and shields.

![Holy protective effects](images/visual-holy-protection.png)

### What to look for

A Paladin works without a spell book at first. The Iron Mace is a normal melee weapon made from an iron ingot and a stick, and the official class description starts the journey with any melee weapon. The class spells arrive with the Paladin Libram, which the publisher says works best with heavy weapons such as hammers and claymores.

The Iron Mace carries no healing-power bonus, so a player who wants to heal keeps a Holy Wand or an Acolyte Wand for that job. The Acolyte Wand costs a stick and string, and the Holy Wand costs a gold ingot and an iron ingot, which makes the Acolyte Wand the cheapest way to try a healing cast. Check the healing line on the item tooltip before you commit.

Paladin Armor uses copper and iron, so the set is reachable early. The Crusader Armor is the later set and the Netherite Crusader Armor is its smithing upgrade. A shield in the off hand supports a defensive style, and the publisher lists that pairing explicitly.

Runes apply to the spells in the Libram, not to the mace swing. Keep the rune named by the spell you intend to cast and treat the melee weapon as a separate source of damage that needs no ammunition.

A successful first use looks like this. Hit a hostile with the Iron Mace and confirm normal melee damage, bind the Libram at a Spell Binding Table, equip it and hold the same mace, then cast Flash Heal on yourself or an ally and watch health return. If the heal fails while the mace still works, the miss is in the rune supply rather than in the weapon.

### Readiness

These checkpoints are optional. Nothing here is a requirement to play the class.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have an iron ingot and a stick for the Iron Mace, and copper and iron for a Paladin Armor piece. | Fight with the mace. Add Paladin Armor pieces as materials arrive. |
| Early midgame | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves is reachable and its cost is payable. | Bind the Paladin Libram. Keep a Holy or Acolyte Wand if you intend to heal. |
| Midgame | You can compare the mace, great hammer and claymore lines, and a shield is available. | Choose the weapon specialisation that matches your reach and speed, then decide whether the shield is worth the off hand. |
| Late game | You hold a netherite upgrade smithing template and netherite ingots. | Upgrade the Crusader Armor pieces one at a time and keep the healing focus you actually cast with. |

## 定位与入门武器

圣骑士把近战与治疗学派辅助结合起来，使用钉锤、巨锤、巨剑与盾牌。

![神圣保护效果](images/visual-holy-protection.png)

### 值得关注的内容

圣骑士起步时不需要法术书。铁钉锤是用铁锭与木棍做出的普通近战武器，官方介绍也说明任何近战武器都可以作为起点。职业法术来自圣骑士圣典，发行方说明它最适合巨锤与巨剑这类重型武器。

铁钉锤没有治疗强度加成，因此想治疗时要把圣光魔杖或侍僧魔杖留在手上。侍僧魔杖的配方是木棍与线，圣光魔杖需要金锭与铁锭，所以侍僧魔杖是尝试治疗施放成本最低的方式。确定之前先看物品提示里的治疗词条。

圣骑士护甲的配方使用铜与铁，因此早期就能凑齐。十字军护甲是更晚的套装，下界合金十字军护甲是它的锻造升级。副手盾牌支持防守打法，发行方也明确提到这种搭配。

符文用于圣典里的法术，不用于钉锤挥击。把准备施放的法术指定的符文带在身上，并把近战武器看作不需要弹药的独立伤害来源。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。用铁钉锤打中敌对生物并确认近战伤害正常，在法术绑定台绑定圣典，装备它并继续手持同一把钉锤，然后对自己或盟友施放快速治疗，看生命值回复。如果钉锤正常而治疗失败，问题出在符文供应而不是武器。

### 准备阶段

这些检查点是可选的。这里没有任何一项是游玩该职业的前提。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有铁锭与木棍做铁钉锤，有铜与铁做一件圣骑士护甲。 | 先用钉锤作战。材料到位时逐件补上圣骑士护甲。 |
| 中期起步 | 能走到周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起费用。 | 绑定圣骑士圣典。打算治疗时保留圣光魔杖或侍僧魔杖。 |
| 中期 | 能比较钉锤、巨锤与巨剑三条线，并有盾牌可用。 | 选择贴合你攻击距离与速度的武器专精，再判断副手是否值得放盾。 |
| 后期 | 持有下界合金升级锻造模板与下界合金锭。 | 逐件升级十字军护甲，并保留实际用来施法的治疗法器。 |

## Role & first weapon

Wind Wizards use air wands and staves for aimed attacks, persistent areas and self effects.

![Elemental Wizard robes](images/visual-elemental-robes.png)

### What to look for

Air spells scale with Air power. The Feather Wand names Air power and costs a feather and a stick, so the first focus is available from the first chickens you meet. Read the school line before you bind a book.

The Air Wand and the Air Staff are the specialist upgrades. The Air Wand uses a phantom membrane, which means a night under open sky or a trade, and the staff continues that line. The Elemental Staff names Air, Earth and Water power at once but needs a nether star, so it is a late goal.

The Wind Robe supports the school with wind charges and wool, and its chest piece also needs gold. The Hurricane Robe is a later upgrade that uses an epic armor upgrade and a warden upgrade crystal. The Elemental Robe covers all three elemental schools.

Air abilities move and hold space. Twister and Tornado are areas that stay on the field, while Updraft and Windfield need a target. A build that pushes enemies away and then drops an area on the ground needs runes for both casts.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Feather Wand, cast at a hostile that is chasing you and see it lose ground or stop, then cast Twister where it stands. If the target does not move, check that the spell is the aimed one rather than the ground one.

### Readiness

The stages below are optional. They describe access and capability, not a required order.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have a feather, a stick and the rune the wand spell names. | Craft the Feather Wand and cast once at a hostile. |
| Early midgame | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves is reachable and its cost is payable. | Bind the Wind book and equip it with a compatible focus held. |
| Midgame | Wind charges and a phantom membrane are available to you. | Compare the Wind Robe with the Air Staff, and keep the general robe if its bonus serves your casts better. |
| Late game | You can obtain an epic armor upgrade or a nether star. | Choose one goal at a time and check the school bonus on the result before replacing a working piece. |

## 定位与入门武器

风系法师使用风魔杖与法杖，招式包含瞄准攻击、持续范围与自身效果。

![元素法师长袍](images/visual-elemental-robes.png)

### 值得关注的内容

风系法术按风强度计算。羽毛魔杖提供风强度，配方只要羽毛与木棍，遇到第一批鸡之后就能做出。绑定职业书之前，先读清学派词条。

风魔杖与风法杖是专精升级。风魔杖需要幻翼膜，意味着露天过夜或交易，法杖延续这条线。元素法杖同时提供风、土与水强度，但需要下界之星，因此属于后期目标。

风之长袍用风弹与羊毛支撑本学派，胸甲额外需要金锭。飓风长袍是更晚的升级，配方使用史诗护甲升级与监守者升级水晶。元素长袍覆盖三种元素学派。

风系招式用来改变位置与占住空间。旋风与龙卷是留在场上的范围，上升气流与风场需要目标。先把敌人推开再往地面放范围的构筑，符文要备足两种施放。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持羽毛魔杖，对追着你的敌对生物施放，看它被推开或停住，再在它所在的位置施放旋风。如果目标完全不移动，先确认用的是瞄准法术而不是地面法术。

### 准备阶段

下面阶段都是可选的。它们描述能接触到什么、能做到什么，不是必经顺序。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有羽毛、木棍，以及魔杖法术指定的符文。 | 做出羽毛魔杖，对一个敌对生物施放一次。 |
| 中期起步 | 能走到周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起费用。 | 绑定风系职业书，手持兼容法器时装备它。 |
| 中期 | 能取得风弹与幻翼膜。 | 比较风之长袍与风法杖。如果通用长袍的加成更贴合你的施放，就继续用它。 |
| 后期 | 能获得一次史诗护甲升级或下界之星。 | 一次只选一个目标，替换在用部件之前先确认新部件的学派加成。 |

## Role & first weapon

Terra Wizards use earth wands and staves for protection, aimed attacks and ground effects.

![Elemental Wizard robes](images/visual-elemental-robes.png)

### What to look for

Earth spells scale with Earth power. The Clay Wand names Earth power, and the recipe costs a clay ball and a stick, so the first focus is available before any mining trip. Read the school line before you bind a book.

Earth abilities in the book are split between protection and aimed attacks. Stone Flesh and Earth Golem are the defensive options, while Impale and Terra Circle need a target. A build that uses both needs runes for both kinds of cast.

The Terra Wand and the Terra Staff are the specialist upgrades, and the staff adds raw iron work. The Elemental Staff names Air, Earth and Water power at once but needs a nether star, so it is a late goal.

The Dripstone Robe supports the school with pointed dripstone and wool, and its chest piece also needs a dripstone block. The Mountain Robe is a later upgrade that uses an epic armor upgrade and a warden upgrade crystal. The Elemental Robe covers all three elemental schools.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Clay Wand, cast at one aimed target and confirm the hit, then cast Stone Flesh and check that its protection shows on you before a fight rather than during one. If the armour value does not change, the spell did not cast and its rune was not spent.

### Readiness

The hints below are optional. Each stage describes what you can already do, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have clay and a stick, and the rune the wand spell names. | Craft the Clay Wand and cast once. Add Elemental Robe pieces when wool is spare. |
| Early midgame | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves is reachable and its cost is payable. | Bind the Terra book and equip it with a compatible focus held. |
| Midgame | Pointed dripstone is available and you can compare the Terra Wand with the Terra Staff. | Choose the Dripstone Robe path or stay with the general robe by the school bonus each piece gives. |
| Late game | You can obtain an epic armor upgrade or a nether star. | Treat the Mountain Robe and the Elemental Staff as separate goals, and upgrade one piece at a time. |

### Example starter outfit

An example starter outfit: the class starter weapon with the first armor set in its catalog. It is one craftable option, not the official or best build.

## 定位与入门武器

土系法师使用土魔杖与法杖，招式包含保护、瞄准攻击与地面效果。

![元素法师长袍](images/visual-elemental-robes.png)

### 值得关注的内容

土系法术按土强度计算。黏土魔杖提供土强度，配方只要黏土球与木棍，因此第一件法器不需要先挖矿。绑定职业书之前，先读清学派词条。

职业书里的土系招式分成保护与瞄准两类。石肤与土魔像是防御选项，穿刺与土之环需要目标。两类都会用到的构筑，符文要备足两种用途。

土魔杖与土法杖是专精升级，法杖还要用到粗铁。元素法杖同时提供风、土与水强度，但需要下界之星，因此属于后期目标。

滴水石长袍用尖滴水石与羊毛支撑本学派，胸甲额外需要滴水石块。山岳长袍是更晚的升级，配方使用史诗护甲升级与监守者升级水晶。元素长袍覆盖三种元素学派。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持黏土魔杖，对一个瞄准目标施放并确认命中，然后在战斗开始前施放石肤，确认保护已经生效。如果护甲数值没有变化，说明法术没有施放，符文也就没有消耗。

### 准备阶段

下面的提示是可选的。每个阶段描述你已经具备的能力，而不是游玩了多久。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有黏土、木棍，以及魔杖法术指定的符文。 | 做出黏土魔杖并施放一次。羊毛有余时补上元素长袍部件。 |
| 中期起步 | 能走到周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起费用。 | 绑定土系职业书，手持兼容法器时装备它。 |
| 中期 | 能取得尖滴水石，并能比较土魔杖与土法杖。 | 按每件装备的学派加成，在滴水石长袍路线与通用长袍之间选择。 |
| 后期 | 能获得一次史诗护甲升级或下界之星。 | 把山岳长袍与元素法杖当作两个独立目标，并且每次只升级一件。 |

### 入门配装示例

入门配装示例：职业入门武器搭配目录中的第一套护甲。这是一种可合成选择，并非官方或最优构筑。

## Role & first weapon

Aqua Wizards use water wands and staves for damaging spells and support areas.

![Elemental Wizard robes](images/visual-elemental-robes.png)

### What to look for

Water spells scale with Water power. The Kelp Wand names Water power and costs only kelp and a stick, so the first focus needs an ocean visit rather than a mining trip. Read the school line before you bind a book.

The Aqua Wand and the Aqua Staff are the specialist upgrades. The Elemental Staff names Air, Earth and Water power in one item, which suits a player who keeps several elemental books. It also costs a nether star, so it is a late goal rather than a starting focus.

The Kelp Robe supports the school with kelp, wool and prismarine crystals. The Ocean Robe is a later upgrade that uses an epic armor upgrade and a warden upgrade crystal, so it depends on other content. The Elemental Robe covers all three elemental schools and is the general entry.

This class carries support in its own book. Springwater and Healing Rain Cloud are area effects, so bring enough runes for a heal as well as for a damage spell. The tooltip of each spell names its cost, and a spell with no rune cost consumes nothing.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Kelp Wand, cast at a hostile and confirm the water spell lands, then cast Springwater among allies and watch the area effect appear. If the second cast fails, the missing piece is usually the healing rune rather than the wand.

### Readiness

These are optional suggestions, not a required sequence or a count of days played.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have kelp, a stick and the rune the wand spell names. | Craft the Kelp Wand and cast once. Add the Elemental Robe pieces as materials allow. |
| Early midgame | You can use a Spell Binding Table with bookshelves and pay the displayed cost. | Bind the Aqua book and equip it with a compatible focus held. |
| Midgame | Prismarine crystals are available and you can compare the Aqua Wand with the Aqua Staff. | Choose between the Kelp Robe and the Aqua robe path by the school bonus each piece gives. |
| Late game | You can obtain a nether star or an epic armor upgrade. | Treat the Elemental Staff and the Ocean Robe as separate goals. Neither one is required for the other. |

## 定位与入门武器

水系法师使用水魔杖与法杖，招式包含伤害法术与辅助范围。

![元素法师长袍](images/visual-elemental-robes.png)

### 值得关注的内容

水系法术按水强度计算。海带魔杖只提供水强度，配方只要海带与木棍，因此第一件法器需要一次海洋行程，而不是挖矿行程。绑定职业书之前，先读清学派词条。

水魔杖与水法杖是专精升级。元素法杖同时提供风、土与水强度，适合保留多本元素职业书的玩家，但配方需要下界之星，所以它是后期目标，不是起步法器。

海带长袍用海带、羊毛与海晶砂粒支撑本学派。海洋长袍是更晚的升级，配方使用史诗护甲升级与监守者升级水晶，因此依赖其他内容。元素长袍覆盖三种元素学派，是通用入门套装。

这个职业书本身带有辅助招式。清泉与治疗雨云都是范围效果，因此符文要同时留出治疗与伤害的用量。每条法术的提示都会写明消耗，没有符文消耗的法术不消耗任何符文。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持海带魔杖，对敌对生物施放并确认水系法术命中，再在盟友之间施放清泉，看到范围效果出现。如果第二次施放失败，缺少的通常是治疗类符文，而不是魔杖。

### 准备阶段

以下都是可选建议，不是必经顺序，也不按游玩天数划分。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有海带、木棍，以及魔杖法术指定的符文。 | 做出海带魔杖并施放一次。材料允许时补上元素长袍部件。 |
| 中期起步 | 能使用周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起显示的费用。 | 绑定水系职业书，手持兼容法器时装备它。 |
| 中期 | 能取得海晶砂粒，并能比较水魔杖与水法杖。 | 按每件装备给出的学派加成，在海带长袍与水系长袍之间选择。 |
| 后期 | 能获得下界之星或一次史诗护甲升级。 | 把元素法杖与海洋长袍当作两个独立目标。两者互不要求。 |

## Role & first weapon

Frost Wizards use frost wands and staves for area attacks, protection and projectiles.

![Frost spell effects](images/visual-frost-magic.png)

### What to look for

Frost spells scale with Frost power. The Frost Wand names Frost power, and the general Wizard Staff names Arcane, Fire and Frost power together, so a wand keeps the school focused. Read the school line before you bind a book.

The Frost Wand recipe uses an iron ingot and a snowball, which makes it one of the cheapest school focuses in the mod. The Frost Staff adds prismarine crystals, so it waits for an ocean visit. The staff also carries a stronger weapon spell than the wand, and the tooltip shows what it costs.

The general Wizard Robe covers any school with wool and lapis lazuli. The Frost Robe uses a prismarine shard per piece, so it follows the same ocean trip as the staff. A Netherite Frost Robe piece is a smithing upgrade of the matching Frost Robe piece.

Frost Shield is a self effect in the book, so a frost build can hold a position while its area spells land. Pair the focus with the rune type its spells name, in the inventory or in an equipped pouch, and keep enough for a shield cast as well as an attack.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Frost Wand, gather two or three hostiles in front of you, cast the wand spell and see the rune count drop while every target in the area reacts. If only one target reacts, the spell is aimed rather than an area spell, which the tooltip states.

### Readiness

The order is optional. Each row describes a condition, not a required chapter.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You have an iron ingot, a snowball and the rune the wand spell names. | Craft the Frost Wand and cast once at a hostile. |
| Early midgame | You can reach a Spell Binding Table with bookshelves and pay the displayed cost. | Bind the Frost book and equip it with a compatible focus held. |
| Midgame | Prismarine shards and crystals are available from an ocean trip. | Compare the Frost Robe with the Frost Staff. Keep the general robe if the school bonus on the specialist piece does not help your spells. |
| Late game | You hold a netherite upgrade smithing template and netherite ingots. | Upgrade one Frost Robe piece at a time, then compare the result with the piece you replace. |

## 定位与入门武器

冰霜法师使用冰霜魔杖与法杖，招式包含范围攻击、保护与投射物。

![冰霜法术效果](images/visual-frost-magic.png)

### 值得关注的内容

冰霜法术按冰霜强度计算。冰霜魔杖只提供冰霜强度，通用巫师法杖同时提供奥术、火焰与冰霜强度，因此魔杖更适合专修。绑定职业书之前，先读清学派词条。

冰霜魔杖的配方需要铁锭与雪球，是本模组里成本较低的学派法器之一。冰霜法杖还需要海晶砂粒，因此要等一次海洋行程。法杖自带的武器法术强于魔杖，消耗写在提示里。

通用巫师长袍用羊毛与青金石就能覆盖任何学派。冰霜长袍每件需要海晶碎片，与法杖一样要等海洋行程。下界合金冰霜长袍是把对应的冰霜长袍部件锻造升级。

霜盾在职业书中是自身效果，因此冰霜构筑可以守住位置，让范围法术持续落下。把法术指定的符文带在身上，放在背包或已装备的符文袋中，并留出一次护盾的用量与一次攻击的用量。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持冰霜魔杖，把两三个敌对生物聚到面前，施放魔杖法术，符文减少，范围内的目标都有反应。如果只有一个目标有反应，说明这是瞄准型法术而不是范围法术，提示里会写明。

### 准备阶段

下面顺序是可选的。每行描述一个条件，不是必须完成的章节。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 有铁锭、雪球，以及魔杖法术指定的符文。 | 做出冰霜魔杖，对一个敌对生物施放一次。 |
| 中期起步 | 能使用周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起显示的费用。 | 绑定冰霜职业书，手持兼容法器时装备它。 |
| 中期 | 一次海洋行程带回了海晶碎片与海晶砂粒。 | 比较冰霜长袍与冰霜法杖。如果专精部件的学派加成帮不到你的法术，就继续用通用长袍。 |
| 后期 | 持有下界合金升级锻造模板与下界合金锭。 | 每次升级一件冰霜长袍部件，再把结果与被替换的部件比较。 |

## Role & first weapon

Fire Wizards use fire wands and staves for close area attacks, projectiles and falling attacks.

![Fire spell effects](images/visual-fire-magic.png)

### Example starter outfit

The Novice Wand with the four general Wizard Robe pieces is an example starter outfit, not the official default. The model shows appearance and the held wand, not an equipped spell book.

### What to look for

Fire spells scale with Fire power. The Novice Wand names Fire power only, so it adds nothing to an Arcane or Frost spell while it is held. Read the school line on a focus before you bind a book around it.

A general Wizard Staff names Arcane, Fire and Frost power together, which suits a player who keeps several books. A fire wand or fire staff is the focused choice for a player who casts Fire most of the time. The held focus also carries its own weapon spell, so you can deal damage before any book exists.

The general Wizard Robe needs wool and lapis lazuli and no Nether trip. Each Fire Robe piece needs blaze powder, so that set follows a Nether visit. A Netherite Fire Robe piece is a smithing upgrade of the matching Fire Robe piece, not a separate craft.

Runes are ammunition for weapon spells and for learned spells. Carry the rune named by the spell you intend to cast, loose in the inventory or inside an equipped pouch, and read the cost in its tooltip.

A successful first use looks like this. Hold the Novice Wand, aim at one hostile, cast the wand spell and watch the rune count fall by the stated cost while the target takes fire damage. If nothing happens, check the rune type and the pouch contents before you replace the wand.

### Readiness

These checkpoints are optional suggestions. Each row names a condition you can meet, not a chapter you have to finish.

| Stage | Ready when | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game | You can craft the Novice Wand from coal and a stick, and you hold the rune its spell names. | Cast once at a single target. Add the general Wizard Robe when wool and lapis lazuli are available. |
| Early midgame | You have a Spell Binding Table with bookshelves and can pay the displayed learning cost. | Bind the Fire book and equip it while a compatible focus is held. |
| Midgame | Blaze powder is available, from the Nether or from trading. | Compare the Fire Robe with the Fire Staff. Judge each piece by its school bonus rather than by its name. |
| Late game | You hold a netherite upgrade smithing template and netherite ingots. | Upgrade one Fire Robe piece at a time. This is an equipment step, not a measure of boss readiness. |

### 值得关注的内容

火焰法术按火焰强度计算。新手魔杖只提供火焰强度，手持时不会增强奥术或冰霜法术。围绕法器绑定职业书之前，先读清它的学派词条。

通用巫师法杖同时提供奥术、火焰与冰霜强度，适合经常更换职业书的玩家。长期主修火焰时，火焰魔杖或火焰法杖更专注。手持法器自带武器法术，因此在拥有职业书之前就能造成伤害。

通用巫师长袍只需要羊毛与青金石，不必进入下界。火焰长袍每件都需要烈焰粉，所以这套装备要先去下界。下界合金火焰长袍是把对应的火焰长袍部件锻造升级，不是另外制作一件。

符文既是武器法术的弹药，也是已学法术的弹药。把准备施放的法术所指定的符文带在身上，可以散放在背包，也可以装进已装备的符文袋，并在提示中查看消耗。

一次成功的初次使用是这样的。手持新手魔杖，瞄准一个敌对生物，施放魔杖法术，符文数量按提示减少，目标受到火焰伤害。如果毫无反应，先核对符文类型与袋中内容，再考虑换掉魔杖。

### 准备阶段

以下检查点都是可选建议。每行给出一个可以满足的条件，而不是必须走完的章节。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期 | 能用煤炭与木棍做出新手魔杖，并持有其法术指定的符文。 | 先对单个目标施放一次。有羊毛与青金石时补上通用巫师长袍。 |
| 中期起步 | 拥有周围有书架的法术绑定台，并付得起界面显示的学习费用。 | 绑定火焰职业书，手持兼容法器时装备该职业书。 |
| 中期 | 能取得烈焰粉，来自下界或交易。 | 比较火焰长袍与火焰法杖。按学派加成判断每件装备，而不是只看名称。 |
| 后期 | 持有下界合金升级锻造模板与下界合金锭。 | 每次升级一件火焰长袍部件。这是装备步骤，不代表已经适合挑战首领。 |

Arcane Wizards use arcane wands and staves for projectiles, beams, area attacks and self effects.

### Example starter outfit

An Arcane Wand with the four Wizard Robe pieces is one craftable starting outfit, not a required or universally best build. The model shows appearance and the held wand, not an equipped spell book.

Ready for basic casting when you have the wand and the rune supply required by its spell. The wand recipe needs amethyst and gold. The general robes need wool and lapis lazuli. A class book is the next step, not a prerequisite for the wand's own basic spell.

These are optional readiness checkpoints, not a required order or a measure of days played.

| Stage | Next decision |
| --- | --- |
| Early game: first casts | Start with the Arcane Wand. Use the general robes if you can craft them. Check the spell tooltip for its rune cost. |
| Early midgame: book casting | Access a Spell Binding Table with bookshelves, meet the displayed learning costs, equip the Arcane book and hold compatible equipment. |
| Midgame: school investment | Compare Arcane robes and the Arcane Staff once ender pearls are available. Check school bonuses rather than replacing equipment by name alone. |
| Late game: netherite upgrade | Follow the selected smithing recipe once its template and materials are available. This is an equipment upgrade, not proof of boss readiness. |

### Readiness & first fight

Forcemasters fight with knuckles, and the publisher describes the class as a fast attacking fighter that stuns and knocks targets up. Each hit carries arcane force, so the knuckle family and the Arcane power line on the armor matter more than weapon reach. Oriene, Phasleb, Aken and Billporon are the four armor families. A good first fight is one target kept in a short stun while you land repeated hits, rather than a long exchange with several mobs.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first knuckles | A knuckle, food, and a single target to test the stun timing. | Craft the iron knuckle. Start with wooden or stone knuckles if iron is short. |
| Early midgame: book | A Spell Binding Table, the Forcemaster book, and its learning cost. | Bind the book and equip it. Hold the knock up ability for the moment a mob winds up. |
| Midgame: armor | Two or more pieces from one forcemaster family. | Compare the Arcane power and protection lines. Complete one family before mixing pieces. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials and a unique knuckle from chest loot. | Upgrade the knuckle you use and compare a found unique against it. |

### Readiness & first fight

The Berserker is a physical melee class built on the Rage attribute, and the publisher states that the lower your health, the more damage you deal. That makes the axe family and a plan for leaving a fight more important than a perfect set. Wildling and Northling armor carry the rage bonuses and Warlord armor is the fourth family. A good first fight is a mob killed while you are wounded but in control, with an ability ready to break contact.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first axe | A berserker axe, food, and a safe place to test the rage bonus. | Craft the iron berserker axe. Fight one mob at a time until you recognise how much health you can spend. |
| Early midgame: book | A Spell Binding Table, the Berserker book, and its learning cost. | Bind the book and keep one defensive or healing option in reserve, since the class rewards low health. |
| Midgame: armor | Wildling or Northling armor pieces. | Complete one family. Read the tooltip for the rage line before replacing a piece. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials and the matching northling piece, or a unique axe from chest loot. | Upgrade northling armor and compare a found unique axe against your crafted one before switching. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

狂战士是以怒气属性为核心的物理近战职业，发布说明写明生命越低，造成的伤害越高。因此斧类武器与一套退出战斗的计划，比完美套装更重要。荒原与北地护甲提供怒气加成，督军护甲是第四个家族。一次成功的首战，是你在带伤但仍有掌控的情况下解决一只怪物，并留有脱离接触的招式。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次用斧 | 一把狂战士斧、食物，以及一处能安全测试怒气加成的场地。 | 合成铁狂战士斧。先一次只打一只怪物，摸清自己能花掉多少生命。 |
| 中期起步：职业书 | 法术绑定台、狂战士职业书，以及学习费用。 | 绑定职业书，并保留一个防御或治疗手段，因为这个职业奖励低生命。 |

### Readiness & first fight

Warriors use heavy, slow weapons, and the publisher lists double axes and glaives for the Warrior Codex. Each swing commits you, so the class pays off when you choose the moment and use charge or shouts to close the distance. Warrior armor is the entry set and Berserker armor is the heavier family in the same list. A good first fight is a charge into two mobs followed by one area ability, ending with you still standing and the group thinned.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first heavy weapon | A double axe or a glaive, food, and room to swing. | Craft the iron double axe. Practise the swing timing on a single mob before fighting groups. |
| Early midgame: warrior codex | A Spell Binding Table, the Warrior Codex, and its learning cost. | Bind the codex. Keep a thrown or charging ability ready for the moment a mob backs away. |
| Midgame: armor | Warrior armor pieces, or berserker armor pieces. | Complete the warrior set first. Treat berserker armor as a separate choice, not a free upgrade. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials and a berserker armor piece. | Upgrade the berserker set only if you intend to stay in melee. Otherwise spend the materials on your weapon path. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

战士使用重型慢速武器，发布说明为战士法典列出双刃斧与长柄刀。每次挥击都需要你先站定，因此选准时机、用冲锋或战吼拉近距离，才是这个职业的收益所在。战士护甲是入门套装，狂战士护甲是同一列表中的更重家族。一次成功的首战，是冲进两只怪物中间接一个范围招式，结束时你仍然站立而怪群已被削薄。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次重武器 | 一把双刃斧或长柄刀、食物，以及足够的挥击空间。 | 先合成铁双刃斧。先在单只怪物身上练习挥击节奏，再打群战。 |
| 中期起步：战士法典 | 法术绑定台、战士法典，以及学习费用。 | 绑定法典，并留一个投掷或冲锋招式，应对怪物后撤的瞬间。 |
| 中期：护甲 | 战士护甲，或狂战士护甲。 | 先凑齐战士套装。把狂战士护甲当作另一个选择，而不是免费升级。 |
| 后期：下界合金 | 下界合金材料，以及狂战士护甲部件。 | 只有在打算长期近战时才升级狂战士套装，否则把材料用在武器路线上。 |

### Readiness & first fight

The Rogue book is built around evading attacks and tricking opponents, and its publisher recommends dual wielded quick weapons, which means a dagger or a sickle in each hand. Damage per swing is lower than a heavy weapon, so the class wins by attacking between enemy swings and by setting a prepared effect before the fight starts. Rogue armor supports that rhythm and assassin armor is the next family in the same list. A good first fight is one mob killed in a short exchange after a shock powder or a trap, with your health nearly untouched.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first daggers | Two quick weapons, ideally a dagger beside a sickle, and food. | Craft the iron dagger and pair it with any second quick weapon. Confirm both hands hold a weapon before you rely on the off hand. |
| Early midgame: rogue manual | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves, the Rogue Manual, and its learning cost. | Bind the manual and equip it. Set one prepared effect before you enter a fight rather than casting mid swing. |
| Midgame: armor | Rogue armor pieces, or assassin pieces as the stronger family. | Complete one set. Compare attack speed and damage on the weapon before swapping a set for a single piece. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials, the template, and an assassin armor piece. | Upgrade the assassin set and keep a trap or an escape ability bound for group fights. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

盗贼职业书围绕闪避与戏弄对手，发布说明建议双持快速武器，也就是一手匕首或一手镰刀。单次挥击伤害低于重型武器，因此职业强度来自在敌人挥击之间出刀，以及在开战前布好预备效果。盗贼护甲贴合这种节奏，刺客护甲是同一列表中的下一套。一次成功的首战，是用震撼粉或陷阱之后的一段短促交手解决一只怪物，而生命几乎未损。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次双持 | 两把快速武器，最好一把匕首配一把镰刀，以及食物。 | 合成铁匕首，再配任意第二把快速武器。确认两只手都握有武器，再依赖副手。 |
| 中期起步：盗贼手册 | 周围有书架的法术绑定台、盗贼手册，以及学习费用。 | 绑定并装备手册。进战前先设好一个预备效果，而不是挥击到一半再施法。 |
| 中期：护甲 | 盗贼护甲，或更强的刺客护甲。 | 先凑齐一套。更换套装前，先比较武器的攻击速度与伤害。 |
| 后期：下界合金 | 下界合金材料、锻造模板，以及刺客护甲部件。 | 升级刺客套装，并为群战保留一个陷阱或脱身招式。 |

### Readiness & first fight

War Archers trade frost slows for burning areas and burst damage, and the publisher describes the War Archer set as the bulky armor option for a safer ranged playstyle. Fire and explosive abilities reward hitting a cluster, so a weapon that reaches a group matters more than a single target bow. Sentinel Archer is the alternate armor family. A good first fight is a group cleared by one burning area and follow up arrows, with no mob left close enough to trade hits.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first burning shot | A bow or crossbow, ammunition, and one ability that leaves fire on the ground. | Craft the composite longbow, then aim at the ground a mob is walking into rather than at the mob itself. |
| Early midgame: book | A Spell Binding Table, the War Archer book, and its learning cost. | Bind the book and keep a shot that pins a target for the area ability that follows. |
| Midgame: armor | War Archer armor pieces, or Sentinel Archer pieces as the alternate family. | Take the set you can complete. The publisher calls War Archer armor the bulkier option, so check its protection line. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials and a war archer or sentinel archer piece. | Upgrade the netherite war archer set before chasing a second family. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

战争弓手把冰霜减速换成燃烧区域与爆发伤害，发布说明把战争弓手套装称为更安全的厚甲远程选择。火焰与爆炸招式奖励命中聚集的敌人，因此能打到怪群的武器比单体弓更有价值。哨兵射手是备选护甲家族。一次成功的首战，是用一片燃烧区域加后续箭矢清掉一群怪物，没有怪物留在近身距离。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |

### Readiness & first fight

The Tundra Hunter book leans on freezing shots and frost areas, so the bow delivers cold rather than carrying the whole build. A longbow gives an area shot time to land where a group stands, while a shortbow keeps you moving between casts. Tundra Hunter and Polar Stalker armor carry the frost and ranged attributes. A good first fight is a mob held inside your frost area long enough to be finished while it moves slowly.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first frost shot | A bow, arrows, and one ability that applies cold. | Start with the composite longbow, then cast into a group rather than a single target so the slow earns its cost. |
| Early midgame: book | A Spell Binding Table, the Tundra Hunter book, and its learning cost. | Bind the book and equip it beside the bow. Keep a melee fallback for mobs that walk out of the frost. |
| Midgame: armor | Tundra Hunter armor pieces, or Polar Stalker pieces as the alternate family. | Choose one family and complete it. Both are ranged sets, so compare the tooltip lines instead of the names. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials and the matching tundra hunter or polar stalker piece. | Upgrade the chest first if you take hits, otherwise the piece whose bonus you rely on most. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

冻原猎手的职业书以冻结射击与冰霜区域为主，弓只是投放寒冷的手段，而不是整个构筑。长弓能让范围招式落在怪群站位上，短弓让你在施法之间保持移动。冻原猎人与极地追猎者护甲提供冰霜与远程属性。一次成功的首战，是把一只怪物留在冰霜区域内，让它在减速中被打完。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次冰霜射击 | 一把弓、箭矢，以及一个附带寒冷效果的招式。 | 先用复合长弓，招式投向怪群而不是单个目标，减速才值得消耗。 |
| 中期起步：职业书 | 法术绑定台、冻原猎手职业书，以及学习费用。 | 绑定职业书并与弓一同装备。为走出冰霜区域的怪物留一手近战。 |
| 中期：护甲 | 冻原猎手护甲，或作为备选家族的极地追猎者护甲。 | 选定一个家族并凑齐。两者都是远程套装，比较提示属性而不是只看名称。 |
| 后期：下界合金 | 下界合金材料，以及对应的冻原猎手或极地追猎者部件。 | 经常挨打就先升级胸甲，否则升级你最依赖的那条加成所在的位置。 |

### Readiness & first fight

Deadeyes stay on the crossbow side of the archery family, and the publisher describes the Deadeye skills as fast and tricky shots with harmful arrows. A crossbow charges once and releases when you choose, so the book's disabling and gas effects fit that rhythm better than a rapid bow. Archer and ranger armor still carry the ranged bonuses, and the Deadeye set adds its own attribute line. A good first fight is two mobs stopped before they reach you, one by a disabling shot and one by plain crossbow damage.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first bolts | A crossbow, bolts, and a clear line of sight. | Craft the rapid crossbow if the materials allow, otherwise start with a vanilla crossbow and learn its charge cycle. |
| Early midgame: deadeye book | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves, the Deadeye book, and its learning cost. | Bind the book, equip it and hold the crossbow. Check each ability's range before you rely on it underground. |
| Midgame: armor | Craftable Deadeye armor pieces, or bounty hunter pieces from the expansion family. | Complete one set rather than mixing a single upgraded piece into plain armor. Compare the tooltip lines. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite materials, the template, and a deadeye or bounty hunter piece. | Upgrade the netherite deadeye set, or take an Armory upgrade from end game loot if you already own the base set. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

神射手属于弓术体系中的弩类，发布说明把神射手招式描述为快速而刁钻的射击，以及附带负面效果的箭。弩装填一次后由你决定何时释放，因此职业书里的致残与毒气招式更贴合这种节奏。弓箭手与游侠护甲仍然提供远程加成，神射手套装另有自己的属性。一次成功的首战，是在两只怪物靠近之前各拦下一次，一只靠致残射击，一只靠普通弩伤。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次射击 | 一把弩、弩箭，以及通畅的射界。 | 材料允许时先做速射弩，否则用原版弩开始，先熟悉装填节奏。 |
| 中期起步：神射手职业书 | 周围有书架的法术绑定台、神射手职业书，以及学习费用。 | 绑定并装备职业书，手持弩。下矿前先确认每个招式的射程。 |
| 中期：护甲 | 可合成的神射手护甲，或扩展包中的赏金猎人护甲。 | 尽量凑齐一套，而不是把单件升级品混进普通护甲。比较提示中的属性。 |
| 后期：下界合金 | 下界合金材料、锻造模板，以及神射手或赏金猎人部件。 | 升级下界合金神射手套装，若已有基础套装，也可使用末地战利品中的军械库升级。 |

### Readiness & first fight

Archery skills work with any bow or crossbow you hold, so the damage comes from the ranged weapon and its ammunition rather than from a separate spell attribute. Longbows suit a patient draw, shortbows suit quick shots while you move, and crossbows charge on their own rhythm. Archer and ranger armor carry the ranged bonuses, so read a piece before you break up a set you already wear. A good first fight is one skeleton or zombie dropped before it closes the distance, with one ability used and arrows still in reserve.

The stages below are optional. They describe what you need on hand and what each step unlocks, not how long you have played.

| Stage | Ready when | Suggested action or next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early game: first shots | A bow or crossbow, a stack of arrows or bolts, and food to recover from a missed shot. | Craft the composite longbow when the materials are at hand, otherwise practise with a vanilla bow. The archery skills accept either. |
| Early midgame: archery manual | A Spell Binding Table with bookshelves beside it, the Archery Manual, and the learning cost its interface shows. | Bind the manual, equip it and keep a ranged weapon in hand. A village Archery Range is one place to find starting equipment. |
| Midgame: armor | Two or more archer or ranger armor pieces, crafted or bought, and enough levels to repair them. | Compare the hover attributes on the pieces you own. Move to ranger armor when its bonuses match the weapon family you settled on. |
| Late game: netherite | Netherite ingots, the smithing template the recipe asks for, and the ranger piece being upgraded. | Upgrade the piece you wear most. Dungeon loot also carries archery equipment, so check a found bow before spending materials. |

### 准备阶段与首次战斗

弓箭手招式可以配合任意手持的弓或弩，伤害来自远程武器与弹药，而不是另一项法术属性。长弓适合从容蓄力，短弓适合移动中快速出手，弩则有自己的装填节奏。弓箭手与游侠护甲提供远程加成，替换已有套装前先看清单件说明。一次成功的首战，是在骷髅或僵尸靠近之前将其击倒，用掉一个招式而箭矢还有余量。

下列阶段均为可选，说明手头需要什么、每一步解锁什么，不按游玩天数衡量。

| 阶段 | 就绪条件 | 建议行动或下一步选择 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 前期：初次射击 | 一把弓或弩、一组箭或弩箭，以及补回失误消耗的食物。 | 材料齐备时先做复合长弓，否则用原版弓练习。弓箭手招式两者都能配合。 |
| 中期起步：弓术手册 | 周围有书架的法术绑定台、弓术手册，以及界面显示的学习费用。 | 绑定并装备手册，手中保持远程武器。村庄的箭术靶场是获取入门装备的地点之一。 |
| 中期：护甲 | 两件以上弓箭手或游侠护甲，可自行合成或购买，并有足够等级维修。 | 比较手中部件的悬停属性。游侠护甲的加成与你选定的武器分类相符时再更换。 |
| 后期：下界合金 | 下界合金锭、配方向导模板要求的锻造模板，以及待升级的游侠护甲部件。 | 优先升级你最常穿的位置。地牢战利品也会出现弓术装备，花材料前先看看捡到的弓。 |

machines.ore-processing.en_us:
## Start with the millstone

The <ItemLink id="create:millstone" /> takes items from above and returns products with an empty-hand right click. Use the waterwheel, vertical gearbox and upward shaft arrangement in [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md), then place the millstone directly above that shaft. Drop one wheat into its top. Turning gears and flour appearing in its output confirm the first job.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/millstone" />

| Machine | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:millstone" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:millstone" /></ItemGrid> | One item at a time, top input, empty-hand right click output |
| <ItemLink id="create:crushing_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:crushing_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | Opposing rotating pair, top input |
| <ItemLink id="create:encased_fan" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:encased_fan" /></ItemGrid> | Processes items in airflow on belts or depots |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_press" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_press" /></ItemGrid> | Presses items on a depot, belt or basin |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_mixer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_mixer" /></ItemGrid> | Stirs items in a basin |

One <ItemLink id="minecraft:wheat" /> guarantees one <ItemLink id="create:wheat_flour" />. There is a separate twenty-five-percent chance for two extra flour, and another twenty-five-percent chance for one <ItemLink id="minecraft:wheat_seeds" />. A successful extra-flour roll therefore gives three flour in total.

<EmiSearch query="Wheat Flour" />

Select the matching result to see the complete input and probabilistic outputs.

***

## Crushing, washing and fan media

The Processing Items with Crushing Wheels lesson shows items inserted at the top between two wheels rotating into each other. Crushing <ItemLink id="minecraft:raw_iron" /> yields one <ItemLink id="create:crushed_raw_iron" /> and has a seventy-five-percent chance for <ItemLink id="create:experience_nugget" />. Washing that crushed iron yields nine <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_nugget" /> and has a seventy-five-percent chance for <ItemLink id="minecraft:redstone" />.

| Fan medium | View | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Water | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:water_bucket" /></ItemGrid> | Washes items |
| Lava | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid> | Blasts items, but destroys food in the airflow |
| Fire or campfire | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:campfire" /></ItemGrid> | Smokes items |
| Soul fire or soul campfire | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:soul_campfire" /></ItemGrid> | Haunts items |

Put the chosen medium in the airflow path, with items carried through it on a belt or depot. Air direction and range depend on rotation. Fan speed affects range, not processing speed. For food, use fire smoking rather than the lava blast.

***

## Press and mix in place

Place a <ItemLink id="create:depot" /> beneath the press for a single item, or use a <ItemLink id="create:basin" /> to press a filled two by two or three by three crafting recipe. Some basin recipes require a heated <ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" />. A basin holds outputs if no valid output faucet is present. With one, output is directed below to the side.

| Station | View | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Depot | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:depot" /></ItemGrid> | Holds an item stack beneath a press |
| Basin | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:basin" /></ItemGrid> | Holds item and fluid batches. Mixer or press works above it |
| Blaze Burner | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /></ItemGrid> | Supplies heat when a basin recipe requires it |

For mixing, place the mixer over the basin and mesh its upper cogwheel with a rotating drive. Check the mixer tooltip for its required speed. Check the basin output faucet or retained contents to confirm completion. Use the recipe browser for the exact mix or press recipe.

<ItemLink id="create:andesite_alloy" /> is a useful first crafting material before scaling the processing workshop.

- [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) First drive layout and stress.
- [Item and fluid routing](machines.logistics.md) Belts and item transfer.
- [Cooking tools](food.utensils.md) Food-specific preparation.

<Recipe id="stam1ocreatetweaks:blasting/blue_dye" />

<EmiSearch query="Phantom Membrane" />

<EmiSearch query="Brown Mushroom Block" />

<EmiSearch query="Red Mushroom Block" />

| Process | Input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Haunting with soul-fire airflow | One <ItemLink id="minecraft:feather" /> | One <ItemLink id="minecraft:phantom_membrane" /> |
| Press and basin compacting | Four <ItemLink id="minecraft:brown_mushroom" /> | One <ItemLink id="minecraft:brown_mushroom_block" /> |

The blue-dye recipe is displayed above. For haunting and compacting, open the shortcut recipes and select the corresponding output's processing recipe. Use soul-fire airflow for the membrane, and the powered press above a basin for the mushroom blocks.

## 从磨石开始

<ItemLink id="create:millstone" /> 从上方接收物品，空手右键取出产物。先按[旋转动力](machines.rotation.md)中的水车、竖直齿轮箱和向上传动轴布置，将磨石直接放在轴上方，再从顶部投入一份小麦。齿轮转动并产生面粉，就说明首次加工成功。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/millstone" />

| 机器 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:millstone" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:millstone" /></ItemGrid> | 一次一件，顶部输入，空手右键取出 |
| <ItemLink id="create:crushing_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:crushing_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | 两个轮子相对旋转，顶部输入 |
| <ItemLink id="create:encased_fan" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:encased_fan" /></ItemGrid> | 在气流中加工传送带或压台上的物品 |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_press" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_press" /></ItemGrid> | 压制压台、传送带或锅盆上的物品 |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_mixer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_mixer" /></ItemGrid> | 搅拌锅盆内物品 |

一份 <ItemLink id="minecraft:wheat" /> 固定产出一份 <ItemLink id="create:wheat_flour" />，另有独立的百分之二十五概率额外产出两份面粉，以及独立的百分之二十五概率产出一颗 <ItemLink id="minecraft:wheat_seeds" />。额外面粉判定成功时，总共得到三份面粉。

<EmiSearch query="小麦面粉" />

选择匹配结果查看完整原料与概率产物。

***

## 粉碎、洗涤与风扇介质

Ponder 的 Processing Items with Crushing Wheels 课程说明，物品从顶部投入两个相对转动的轮子之间。粉碎 <ItemLink id="minecraft:raw_iron" /> 产出一份 <ItemLink id="create:crushed_raw_iron" />，并有百分之七十五概率得到 <ItemLink id="create:experience_nugget" />。洗涤粉碎粗铁会得到九颗 <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_nugget" />，并有百分之七十五概率得到 <ItemLink id="minecraft:redstone" />。

| 风扇介质 | 外观 | 操作 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 水 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:water_bucket" /></ItemGrid> | 洗涤物品 |
| 熔岩 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid> | 高炉烧炼，但会摧毁气流中的食物 |
| 火或营火 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:campfire" /></ItemGrid> | 烟熏物品 |
| 灵魂火或灵魂营火 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:soul_campfire" /></ItemGrid> | 缠魂物品 |

把选定介质放在气流路径中，让传送带或压台带着物品穿过。气流方向与范围取决于旋转。风扇转速影响范围，不影响加工速度。加工食物时用火烟熏，不要用熔岩高炉。

***

## 原位压制与混合

把 <ItemLink id="create:depot" /> 放在压机下方可压制单件物品，或用 <ItemLink id="create:basin" /> 压制填满的二乘二或三乘三合成配方。部分锅盆配方需要 <ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> 加热。没有有效出料龙头时，锅盆会保留产物。装有龙头时，产物会导向下方侧面。

| 工作台 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 压台 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:depot" /></ItemGrid> | 在压机下方托住物品堆 |
| 锅盆 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:basin" /></ItemGrid> | 容纳物品与流体批次，供上方搅拌器或压机加工 |
| 烈焰燃烧器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /></ItemGrid> | 为要求加热的锅盆配方供热 |

混合时把搅拌器放在锅盆上方，并让上部齿轮与传动齿轮咬合。根据搅拌器提示提供所需转速，查看出料龙头或锅盆内保留的产物确认完成。准确的混合或压制配方请查配方浏览器。

<ItemLink id="create:andesite_alloy" /> 是扩建加工工坊前常用的合成材料。

- [旋转动力](machines.rotation.md) 第一套传动与应力。
- [物品与流体输送](machines.logistics.md) 传送带与物品移动。
- [烹饪工具](food.utensils.md) 食物专用准备方式。

## Start with a knife and a board

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /></ItemGrid>

A flint knife and a cutting board are the cheapest way into this kitchen. A knife also gathers straw from grassy plants and gives extra drops from animals, so it pays for itself before any station exists.

<Recipe id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" />

Place the board, use a <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cabbage" /> on it, then use the board while holding the knife. The cabbage becomes two <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cabbage_leaf" />, which is your first useful food part and the green ingredient in several soups.

***

## A campsite meal

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:campfire" /></ItemGrid>

A pot needs heat directly below it, and a campfire is enough. A stove is a convenience that never needs fuel, not a requirement for the first meal.

1. Place a lit campfire, then place the pot directly on top of it, one block above the flame with nothing in between.
2. Use the pot and put one brown mushroom and one red mushroom in two ingredient slots.
3. Put one bowl in the container slot.
4. Wait about ten seconds. Bubbles and a campfire icon mean the pot is heated, and the stew leaves the pot inside your bowl.

<Recipe id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" />

<GameScene zoom="4" interactive={true}>
  <IsometricCamera yaw="135" pitch="15" />
  <Block x="0" y="0" z="0" id="farmersdelight:stove" p:lit="true" p:facing="north" />
  <Block x="0" y="1" z="0" id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" p:facing="north" p:support="none" />
  <BlockAnnotation x="0" y="1" z="0" color="#F28CBD">
    Cooking pot, one block above the heat
  </BlockAnnotation>
  <BlockAnnotation x="0" y="0" z="0" color="#F28CBD">
    Lit stove, one of the heat sources a pot accepts
  </BlockAnnotation>
</GameScene>

The scene shows a lit stove because that is the tidy permanent setup. The same placement works on a campfire.

A handheld meal needs no pot at all. A <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:mutton_wrap" /> is bread, cooked mutton, a leafy green and an onion in a shapeless recipe, so it needs no kitchen station.

## Board tools

| Tool | Identify it | Board operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /></ItemGrid> | Cuts food and opens grain, for example a cabbage into two leaves |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_axe" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_axe" /></ItemGrid> | Strips logs and takes baskets apart into canvas |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_shovel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_shovel" /></ItemGrid> | Breaks clay and gravel down, for example clay into clay balls |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_pickaxe" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_pickaxe" /></ItemGrid> | Breaks bricks back into four bricks, and nether bricks into four nether bricks |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:shears" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:shears" /></ItemGrid> | Recovers one leather from leather armor and two leather from leather horse armor |

A knife loses one durability per item processed. The board reads your off hand first, so an ingredient in the off hand and a tool in the main hand repeats the same cut.

***

## Pot, skillet and stove

The pot has six ingredient slots and one container slot. Campfires, soul campfires, fire, soul fire, lava, magma blocks and a lit stove all heat it, and it never burns fuel. A loaded pot can be moved with its meals inside, but its ingredient slots drop.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:skillet" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:stove" /></ItemGrid>

A held skillet cooks one item beside heat and a placed skillet cooks a whole stack. A lit stove holds six items and cooks campfire recipes without fuel, and its top face must stay clear of blocks.

| Station | Heat | Capacity | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Skillet in hand | Any nearby heat | One item | Cooking while travelling |
| Placed skillet | Heat block underneath | One stack | A batch beside a hopper |
| Stove | None after lighting | Six items | Fuel free cooking at a base |
| Cooking pot | Heat block underneath | Six ingredients and one container | Combined meals |

| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:honey_glazed_ham_block" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:honey_glazed_ham_block" /></ItemGrid> | <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:honey_glazed_ham" /> | A bowl |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:shepherds_pie_block" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:shepherds_pie_block" /></ItemGrid> | <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:shepherds_pie" /> | A bowl |

Place the feast and use a bowl on it to take one portion. A placed feast gives four portions. The portion item is what you eat, and the display name is not the container it needs.

A placed pie holds four slices. Use it with a knife to take a slice you can carry, or use it empty-handed while you are hungry to eat a slice in place.

## 从一把刀和一块板开始

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /></ItemGrid>

燧石刀和切菜板是进入这个厨房最便宜的路径。刀还能从草类植物收稻草，并从动物身上拿到额外掉落，所以在做出任何设备之前就已经回本。

<Recipe id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" />

放下切菜板，手持 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cabbage" /> 对板使用，再手持刀对板使用。卷心菜变成两张 <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cabbage_leaf" />，这是第一份有用的食材半成品，也是几种汤里的绿叶材料。

***

## 营地一餐

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:campfire" /></ItemGrid>

锅需要正下方有热源，营火就够。灶台是不用燃料的便利设备，不是第一餐的前提。

1. 放下点燃的营火，把锅直接叠在营火上方一格，中间不放别的方块。
2. 使用锅，把棕色蘑菇和红色蘑菇放进两个食材格。
3. 把一个碗放进容器格。
4. 等大约十秒。冒泡并显示营火图标说明已受热，蘑菇煲会带着你放的碗出锅。

<Recipe id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" />

<GameScene zoom="4" interactive={true}>
  <IsometricCamera yaw="135" pitch="15" />
  <Block x="0" y="0" z="0" id="farmersdelight:stove" p:lit="true" p:facing="north" />
  <Block x="0" y="1" z="0" id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" p:facing="north" p:support="none" />
  <BlockAnnotation x="0" y="1" z="0" color="#F28CBD">
    烹饪锅，位于热源上方一格
  </BlockAnnotation>
  <BlockAnnotation x="0" y="0" z="0" color="#F28CBD">
    点燃的灶台，锅接受的热源之一
  </BlockAnnotation>
</GameScene>

图里用点燃的灶台，因为那是整洁的长期方案。同样的摆放放在营火上也能用。

手持料理完全不需要锅。<ItemLink id="farmersdelight:mutton_wrap" /> 是无序配方，用面包、熟羊肉、一种绿叶蔬菜和洋葱做成，不需要任何厨房设备。

***

## 板上的工具

| 工具 | 辨认 | 板上的作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /></ItemGrid> | 切食材、处理谷物，例如一颗卷心菜出两张叶片 |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_axe" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_axe" /></ItemGrid> | 剥原木，拆开篮子得到帆布 |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_shovel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_shovel" /></ItemGrid> | 打散黏土与沙砾，例如黏土块出黏土球 |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_pickaxe" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_pickaxe" /></ItemGrid> | 把砖块拆回四个红砖，把下界砖块拆回四个下界砖 |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:shears" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:shears" /></ItemGrid> | 从皮革护甲取回一个皮革，从皮革马铠取回两个皮革 |

每加工一件，刀消耗一点耐久。板会先读副手，所以食材放副手、工具拿主手可以连续切同一种材料。

***

## 锅、煎锅与灶台

锅有六个食材格和一个容器格。营火、灵魂营火、火、灵魂火、岩浆、岩浆块和点燃的灶台都能加热，锅本身不烧燃料。装满料理的锅可以带着成品搬动，但食材格会掉落。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:skillet" /><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:stove" /></ItemGrid>

手持煎锅靠近热源一次煎一件，放下的煎锅一次处理一整堆。点燃的灶台能放六件物品，不用燃料做营火配方，顶面不能压方块。

| 设备 | 热源 | 容量 | 适合做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 手持煎锅 | 附近任意热源 | 一次一件 | 赶路时煎几块 |
| 放下的煎锅 | 下方热源方块 | 一整堆 | 在基地批量处理 |
| 灶台 | 点燃后不需要 | 六件 | 基地里的免燃料烹饪 |
| 烹饪锅 | 下方热源方块 | 六格食材加一个容器 | 混合料理 |

***

food.hunger.en_us:
## Read a food

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bread" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:cooked_beef" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:apple" /></ItemGrid>

AppleSkin is installed, so the food tooltip shows both values without a key press.

| Line | What it controls | Where you see it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hunger | Refills the visible bar | Tooltip and the hunger bar preview |
| Saturation | The hidden reserve spent before hunger falls | Tooltip and the saturation overlay |
| Effect | A potion icon and its duration | Tooltip as well as your effect list |

Saturation is the number that keeps the bar full while you sprint and fight, so a lower hunger value with higher saturation can still last longer. The effect line is the other half of the choice, and it belongs to the dish rather than to a food family.

***

## Comfort and Nourishment

Farmer's Delight adds two effects, and this pack keeps the vanilla soup override on, so ordinary soups join them.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:mushroom_stew" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:beetroot_soup" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:rabbit_stew" /></ItemGrid>

| Effect | What it does | Visible sign |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Comfort | Provides natural regeneration, regardless of how hungry you are | A scrolling overlay on the health bar, enabled in this pack |
| Nourishment | Prevents the food meter from decreasing, except when healing with saturation | A gilded overlay on the hunger bar, enabled in this pack |

Comfort is the effect to look for when you are hurt and too hungry to regenerate on your own. Nourishment is the effect to look for before a long fight, because the bar stops draining. Read the effect line on the dish you are holding, because the effect comes from the item and not from the bowl or the plate.

The soup override covers <ItemLink id="minecraft:mushroom_stew" />, <ItemLink id="minecraft:beetroot_soup" /> and <ItemLink id="minecraft:rabbit_stew" />, and the pack also makes those three stack to sixteen like a cooked meal.

***

## Food variety

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="solonion:food_book" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbag" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbox" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:golden_lunchbox" /></ItemGrid>

The pack records your last sixteen counted meals, and old entries decay out of the record. A distinct food adds its strongest entry, and eating it again refreshes that entry instead of adding a second one.

<ItemLink id="solonion:food_book" /> shows current food diversity, the benefits above and below their thresholds, and the queue of foods still counting. Benefits are attribute based and include health, damage, regeneration, movement speed and armor toughness, so a wider record is a real stat gain and not only a habit.

| Setting | Value here | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tracked meals | 16 | Only recent meals count |
| Diversity decay | On | Old entries leave the record |
| Repetition | Refreshes one entry | Repeating a dish does not raise diversity |

Two different soups and one feast portion do more for the record than a chest of the same stew, and the Food Book states how many more meals a locked benefit needs.

***

## Carry meals

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbag" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbox" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:golden_lunchbox" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="solonion:lunchbag" /> holds meals in one slot. Sneak and use it to open the container and place food inside. While you are hungry, an ordinary use of a filled container eats from it without opening the screen. One iron block upgrades it to a <ItemLink id="solonion:lunchbox" />, which keeps the contents and adds capacity, and the <ItemLink id="solonion:golden_lunchbox" /> is the largest form.

- [Cooking tools](food.utensils.md) The pot, the board and the meal groups.
- [Crop ingredients](food.growing.md) Cheap bowls from farm crops.
- [Seafood](food.seafood.md) Fish for a wider record.

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft%201.21.1%20Farmer%27s%20Delight%20hunger%20saturation%20diet%20variety%20tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft%201.21.1%20%E5%86%9C%E5%A4%AB%E4%B9%90%E4%BA%8B%20%E9%A5%A5%E9%A5%BF%20%E9%A5%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%BA%A6%20%E9%A5%AE%E9%A3%9F%E5%A4%9A%E6%A0%B7%E6%80%A7%20%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)
food.hunger.zh_cn:
## 先看懂食物

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:bread" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:cooked_beef" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:apple" /></ItemGrid>

本整合包安装了 AppleSkin，食物提示会直接显示两个数值，不需要按键。

| 行 | 控制什么 | 显示位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 饥饿值 | 回复可见的饥饿条 | 物品提示与饥饿条预览 |
| 饱和度 | 饥饿值下降前先消耗的隐藏储备 | 物品提示与饱和度叠加显示 |
| 效果 | 带时长的药水图标 | 物品提示与自身效果列表 |

饱和度决定疾跑与战斗时饥饿条能撑多久，所以饥饿值更低、饱和度更高的食物可能更耐久。效果行是选择的另一半，它属于那道料理，而不属于某一类食物。

***

## 舒适与滋养

Farmer's Delight 增加了两种效果，本整合包保留了原版汤类覆盖，所以普通汤也有它们。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:mushroom_stew" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:beetroot_soup" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:rabbit_stew" /></ItemGrid>

| 效果 | 作用 | 可见标志 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 舒适 | 无论多饿都提供自然生命恢复 | 生命条上的滚动叠加，本整合包已开启 |
| 滋养 | 阻止饥饿条下降，用饱和度回血时除外 | 饥饿条上的金色叠加，本整合包已开启 |

受伤又饿到无法自然回血时，要找带舒适的食物。长时间战斗前，要找带滋养的食物，因为饥饿条不再下降。直接读手上料理的效果行，效果来自物品本身，不来自碗或盘子。

汤类覆盖包括 <ItemLink id="minecraft:mushroom_stew" />、<ItemLink id="minecraft:beetroot_soup" /> 与 <ItemLink id="minecraft:rabbit_stew" />，本整合包还让这三种汤像料理一样堆叠到十六。

***

## 食物多样性

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="solonion:food_book" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbag" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbox" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:golden_lunchbox" /></ItemGrid>

本整合包记录最近十六种计入的料理，旧记录会逐时衰减退出。每种不同食物占一条最强记录，再吃一次只刷新这条，不会新增。

<ItemLink id="solonion:food_book" /> 显示当前食物多样性、各阈值上下方的好处，以及仍在计入的食物队列。好处是属性类的，包含生命、伤害、生命恢复、移动速度与护甲韧性，所以记录越宽，属性收益越实在，而不只是习惯。

| 设定 | 本整合包的取值 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 记录数量 | 16 | 只统计近期料理 |
| 多样性衰减 | 开启 | 旧记录会退出 |
| 重复食用 | 刷新一条 | 再吃同一道菜不提高多样性 |

两种不同的汤加一份盛宴分餐，比一整箱相同的炖菜更有用，食物书也会写明还差几餐才解锁下一档好处。

***

## 带饭出门

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbag" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:lunchbox" /><ItemIcon id="solonion:golden_lunchbox" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="solonion:lunchbag" /> 用一个格子装多种料理。潜行并使用它打开容器，把食物放进去。饥饿时直接使用装有食物的容器即可进食，不会打开界面。用一个铁块可升级成 <ItemLink id="solonion:lunchbox" />，保留内容并增加容量，<ItemLink id="solonion:golden_lunchbox" /> 是最大形态。

- [烹饪工具与料理](food.utensils.md) 锅、切菜板与料理分组。
- [作物食材](food.growing.md) 用农田作物做便宜碗装料理。
- [海鲜料理](food.seafood.md) 用鱼类拓宽饮食记录。

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft%201.21.1%20Farmer%27s%20Delight%20hunger%20saturation%20diet%20variety%20tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft%201.21.1%20%E5%86%9C%E5%A4%AB%E4%B9%90%E4%BA%8B%20%E9%A5%A5%E9%A5%BF%20%E9%A5%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%BA%A6%20%E9%A5%AE%E9%A3%9F%E5%A4%9A%E6%A0%B7%E6%80%A7%20%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

***

## Shulker boxes for the big haul

A vanilla shulker box needs two shulker shells and one chest, and it keeps its contents when broken. Reinforced boxes keep the same behaviour and add a material tier.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Shulker boxes cannot go inside a backpack in this pack, including the reinforced tiers. Carry them in your ordinary inventory instead.

Next step is storage a factory can fill. [Bulk storage](storage.bulk.md) covers vaults and silos.

## Waystone network

![A Waystone above the landscape](images/visual-mountaintop-waystone.png)

A Waystone above the landscape

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mossy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:deepslate_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blackstone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:sandy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:red_nether_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:end_stone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mud_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:prismarine_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:purpur_waystone" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="waystones:waystone" /> becomes a destination only after you use it once. That first use activates it and adds it to your list. An unactivated stone does not appear in the travel screen, which is the usual reason a base you can see is not on the list.

The material is appearance. A mossy, deepslate, blackstone, sandy, nether brick or end stone waystone behaves like the plain one. The screen shows the experience cost and any cooldown before you confirm, so read the row rather than clicking through.

## Portable and shared travel

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_stone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blank_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:white_portstone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_plate" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:dormant_shard" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:attuned_shard" /></ItemGrid>

| Item | Scope | How it works |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_stone" /> | Personal, to any activated stone | Use it to open the list |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:blank_scroll" /> | Personal, one destination | Use it on a waystone to bind it |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /> | Group, stones of the same colour | Connect matching colours |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:white_portstone" /> | Departure only | Trades access for a destination slot |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> | Paired plates | Attune a shard in one, carry it to the other |

A <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> pair is the only one of these that moves you between two fixed points without a waystone at either end. Attune a <ItemLink id="waystones:dormant_shard" /> in the first plate, then use the <ItemLink id="waystones:attuned_shard" /> on the second. Recolour a sharestone with the recipe below to put it in a different group.

<Recipe id="waystones:orange_sharestone_recolor" />

## Tempad

![Tempad destination equipment](images/feedback-tempad.png)

Tempad destination equipment

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tempad:tempad" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_card" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:workstation" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_generator" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_cell" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:card_wallet" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronometer" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_battery" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_broadcaster" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_marker" /></ItemGrid>

A <ItemLink id="tempad:tempad" /> stores <ItemLink id="tempad:location_card" /> entries and opens a <ItemLink id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /> door to one of them. It is a coordinate system, not a network. A saved place is a fixed point, so it does not follow a moving ship, and it does not know whether the destination is still safe.

Power comes from chronon equipment. A <ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_generator" /> with a <ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_cell" /> is the stationary supply, and the <ItemLink id="tempad:workstation" /> is where cards and devices are made. Check the card in the Tempad screen before you step through.

## Moving destinations

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /></ItemGrid>

Waystones: Sable lets a waystone travel on an assembled body. Place and activate the waystone on the ship, and it appears as a destination in the Sable group. It teleports the player to the moving stone, not the ship to another dimension.

Create: AeroWarptics relocates an assembled ship within one dimension. Neither addon is a cross dimension ship transfer. For that, see [Orbital flight](space.vehicle-transfer.md).

## Choosing a system

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:obsidian" /></ItemGrid>

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| A base network you return to | Waystones |
| A group of friends sharing a base | Sharestones |
| Two fixed points with no stone | Warp plates |
| A pocket list of coordinates | Tempad |
| A destination that moves with a ship | Waystones: Sable |

***

## 传送石网络

![山巅上的传送石](images/visual-mountaintop-waystone.png)

山巅上的传送石

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mossy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:deepslate_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blackstone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:sandy_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:red_nether_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:end_stone_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:mud_bricks_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:prismarine_waystone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:purpur_waystone" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="waystones:waystone" /> 只有在你使用过一次之后才成为目的地。第一次使用会激活它并加入你的列表。未激活的石头不会出现在传送界面，这也是明明看得见的基地却不在列表里的常见原因。

材质只是外观。苔石、深板岩、黑石、砂岩、下界砖或末地石传送石与普通传送石行为相同。确认之前先看界面上的经验消耗与冷却，不要一路点过去。

## 随身与共享传送

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_stone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:blank_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:white_portstone" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:warp_plate" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:dormant_shard" /><ItemIcon id="waystones:attuned_shard" /></ItemGrid>

| 物品 | 范围 | 用法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_stone" /> | 个人，通往任意已激活石头 | 使用后打开列表 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:blank_scroll" /> | 个人，单个目的地 | 对传送石使用以绑定 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:orange_sharestone" /> | 群体，同色石头之间 | 连接相同颜色 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:white_portstone" /> | 仅作为出发点 | 用目的地名额换取通行 |
| <ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> | 成对传送板 | 在一块中充能碎片，带到另一块 |

<ItemLink id="waystones:warp_plate" /> 是其中唯一不需要两端有传送石就能在两点间移动的方式。在第一块板中为 <ItemLink id="waystones:dormant_shard" /> 充能，再对第二块使用 <ItemLink id="waystones:attuned_shard" />。用下面的配方给共享石换色，就能把它归入另一组。

<Recipe id="waystones:orange_sharestone_recolor" />

## Tempad

![Tempad 传送设备](images/feedback-tempad.png)

Tempad 传送设备

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tempad:tempad" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_card" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:workstation" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_generator" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_cell" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:card_wallet" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronometer" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:chronon_battery" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:location_broadcaster" /><ItemIcon id="tempad:timedoor_marker" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="tempad:tempad" /> 保存 <ItemLink id="tempad:location_card" /> 条目，并通过 <ItemLink id="tempad:timedoor_projector" /> 打开通往其中一处的门。它是坐标系统，不是网络。保存的位置是固定点，不会跟随移动的船，也不知道目的地是否仍然安全。

能量来自时间粒子设备。<ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_generator" /> 配 <ItemLink id="tempad:chronon_cell" /> 是固定供电，<ItemLink id="tempad:workstation" /> 用来制作卡片与设备。穿门之前先在 Tempad 界面确认卡片。

## 移动目的地

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="waystones:waystone" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:physics_assembler" /></ItemGrid>

Waystones: Sable 让传送石能随已组装载体移动。把传送石装在船上并激活，它就会出现在 Sable 分组里。它把玩家传送到移动中的石头，而不是把船传送到别的维度。

Create: AeroWarptics 在同一维度内迁移已组装的船。两者都不是跨维度搬运整艘船。跨维度请见[轨道飞行](space.vehicle-transfer.md)。

## 如何选择

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:obsidian" /></ItemGrid>

| 需求 | 使用 |
| --- | --- |
| 常回的基地网络 | 传送石 |
| 朋友共用一处基地 | 共享石 |

## Skill development

![Connected class skill paths](images/visual-class-skill-tree.png)

Open skills with <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" />. Pufferfish’s Skills supplies the screen and progression engine, and Skill Tree and More RPG Classes Skill Tree supply the class and weapon branches.

Kills earn tree experience through the supplied definitions, with anti-farming limits and nearby team sharing. Read a connected node before spending points on it. Class points, weapon points and ordinary experience levels are separate resources, and only the first two buy tree nodes.

1. Try a class weapon and its abilities, then open Class Skills and read its root before spending a class point. Exclusive roots prevent combining every class path.
2. Open Weapon Skills separately and spend weapon points on the branch for the weapon you actually use. A class choice and a weapon branch are related decisions, not the same purchase.
3. After a spell modifier, equip the matching book or weapon and use the named ability. Passive nodes instead describe the event that triggers them.

Arcane class modifiers develop the class-book spells, while the staff branch develops the staff itself. Buying one does not buy the other or bind a missing spell.

## 技能成长

![相互连接的职业技能路线](images/visual-class-skill-tree.png)

按 <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> 打开技能界面。Pufferfish’s Skills 提供界面与成长系统，Skill Tree 和 More RPG Classes Skill Tree 提供职业及武器分支。

击杀按自带定义获得技能树经验，并设有防刷限制与附近队友分享。投入点数前先看清相连节点的要求。职业点数、武器点数与普通经验等级是三种不同资源，只有前两种用于购买技能节点。

1. 先试用职业武器与招式，再打开职业技能分类阅读根节点，然后投入职业点。互斥根节点让你不能叠加所有职业路线。
2. 另行打开武器技能分类，把武器点投入实际使用武器对应的分支。职业选择与武器分支相互配合，但不是同一次购买。
3. 选好法术强化节点后，仍要装备对应书籍或武器并使用所指招式。被动节点则需满足其说明的触发条件。

奥术职业强化影响职业书法术，法杖分支发展的则是法杖本身。购买其中一项不会自动获得另一项，也不会绑定尚未学会的法术。
