## What a network needs

A rotating network has capacity from its sources and stress from the machines on it. While stress stays under capacity everything turns. When stress passes capacity the network stalls until the load drops.

| Source | View | Speed in place | Capacity at that speed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:water_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | Eight revolutions per minute | 256 stress units |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_water_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:large_water_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | Four revolutions per minute | 512 stress units |
| <ItemLink id="create:windmill_bearing" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:windmill_bearing" /></ItemGrid> | Set by sail assembly | Compare with a stressometer |
| <ItemLink id="create:steam_engine" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid> | Set by boiler and engine | Compare with a stressometer |

Capacity follows the source's speed, so those two wheel figures are running output. Both wheels take force from adjacent water currents, and covering more sides does not add output.

| Gauge | View | What it reports |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /></ItemGrid> | Stress capacity of the attached network |
| <ItemLink id="create:speedometer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:speedometer" /></ItemGrid> | Speed of attached components |

Both gauges are placed blocks that report the network they attach to. Wearing <ItemLink id="create:goggles" /> shows more detail on either gauge, and a comparator can read them.

***

## First drive

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/water_wheel" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/shaft" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/vertical_gearbox" />

The Millstone help entry is Processing Items in the Millstone.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:millstone" /></ItemGrid>

1. Put a <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> in flowing water and extend a horizontal <ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> from its axle.
2. Place a <ItemLink id="create:vertical_gearbox" /> at the shaft end. Its horizontal opening must face the shaft and a vertical opening must face up. Use the wrench to orient it if needed.
3. Put an upright shaft in that upper opening, with a <ItemLink id="create:millstone" /> directly on top. The shaft enters the millstone from below.
4. Drop wheat into the millstone from above. After grinding finishes, right click the millstone with an empty hand to collect the output.

The drive works when the millstone turns and grinding completes. A shaft that meets the millstone from a face it does not drive will not transfer force, which looks like a stalled network without being an overload.

Items can also be inserted and extracted by automation. The top accepts input, and the output is available from the block.

***

## Ratio, axis and reversal

| Part | View | What it does to the drive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:shaft" /></ItemGrid> | Passes rotation along the same axis |
| <ItemLink id="create:cogwheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:cogwheel" /></ItemGrid> | Meshing equal-sized gears keep the same speed and reverse rotation |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_cogwheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:large_cogwheel" /></ItemGrid> | Meshing with a small cog doubles speed from large to small and halves it from small to large |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearbox" /> and <ItemLink id="create:vertical_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:gearbox" /><ItemIcon id="create:vertical_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | Relays around corners, and straight connections come out reversed |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearshift" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:gearshift" /></ItemGrid> | Straight relay that reverses while powered by redstone |
| <ItemLink id="create:wrench" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid> | Rotates and configures placed kinetic blocks |

An ordinary gearbox mirrors the shafts around a corner, while a parallel gearbox turns them the same way. Both reverse a straight connection.

Create: Connected adds parts for specific routing cases.

| Part | View | Difference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:cross_connector" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:cross_connector" /></ItemGrid> | Relays rotation across without the lines meeting |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:parallel_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:parallel_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | Corner shafts same direction, straight connections reversed |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:six_way_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:six_way_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | Takes shafts on all six sides |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brass_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brass_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | Each face is set with a wrench |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:encased_chain_cogwheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:encased_chain_cogwheel" /></ItemGrid> | Chain drive that also takes a cogwheel |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /></ItemGrid> | Transfers a set amount of capacity between two separate networks, adjustable on its value panel |

***

## Switches that protect a line

| Part | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:clutch" /></ItemGrid> | Redstone cuts the branch while the source keeps turning |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inverted_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | Relays only while powered |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inverted_gearshift" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_gearshift" /></ItemGrid> | Reverses by default, and passes unchanged while powered |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:freewheel_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:freewheel_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | Transmits only when input rotation matches its configured direction |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:centrifugal_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:centrifugal_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | Couples according to the configured input-speed threshold |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:shear_pin" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:shear_pin" /></ItemGrid> | Single-use connector, breaks when the network is overstressed |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | Disconnects after its overload delay, fix the load then reset with a wrench or redstone pulse |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brake" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brake" /></ItemGrid> | Applies a heavy stress load when powered by redstone |

***

## 网络需要什么

旋转网络有来源提供的容量与机器产生的应力。应力低于容量时全部转动，超过容量就整条停住，直到负载降下来。

| 来源 | 外观 | 就位时的转速 | 该转速下的容量 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:water_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | 每分钟八转 | 256 应力单位 |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_water_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:large_water_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | 每分钟四转 | 512 应力单位 |
| <ItemLink id="create:windmill_bearing" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:windmill_bearing" /></ItemGrid> | 由帆组决定 | 用应力表比较 |
| <ItemLink id="create:steam_engine" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid> | 由锅炉与引擎决定 | 用应力表比较 |

容量跟随来源的转速，所以两个水车的数字是运转时的输出。两种水车都从相邻水流取力，多盖几面不会继续提高输出。

| 仪表 | 外观 | 报告什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /></ItemGrid> | 所接网络的应力容量 |
| <ItemLink id="create:speedometer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:speedometer" /></ItemGrid> | 所接部件的转速 |

两种仪表都是放下的方块，报告它接入的网络。戴上 <ItemLink id="create:goggles" /> 可以看到更多细节，比较器也能读取它们。

***

## 第一条传动线

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/water_wheel" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/shaft" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/vertical_gearbox" />

石磨的帮助条目是 Processing Items in the Millstone。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:millstone" /></ItemGrid>

1. 将 <ItemLink id="create:water_wheel" /> 放在流水中，从轮轴接出一段水平 <ItemLink id="create:shaft" />。
2. 在轴的末端放 <ItemLink id="create:vertical_gearbox" />，让一个水平接口对准轴、一个垂直接口朝上。需要时用扳手调整方向。
3. 从向上的接口接一段竖轴，再在竖轴正上方放 <ItemLink id="create:millstone" />，让轴从底部接入石磨。
4. 从顶部向石磨丢入小麦。研磨完成后，空手右键石磨取出成品。

石磨开始转并完成研磨，就是这条线工作正常。轴接在不被接受的方向上时什么都不会传递，看起来像网络停摆，但并不是过载。

石磨也支持自动化输入与抽出，顶部进料，成品从方块取出。

***

## 比例、轴向与反转

| 部件 | 外观 | 对传动做了什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:shaft" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:shaft" /></ItemGrid> | 沿同一轴传递旋转 |
| <ItemLink id="create:cogwheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:cogwheel" /></ItemGrid> | 同尺寸齿轮啮合时转速不变、转向相反 |
| <ItemLink id="create:large_cogwheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:large_cogwheel" /></ItemGrid> | 与小齿轮啮合时，大带小转速加倍，小带大转速减半 |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearbox" /> 与 <ItemLink id="create:vertical_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:gearbox" /><ItemIcon id="create:vertical_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | 在拐角处传递，直线连接会反转 |
| <ItemLink id="create:gearshift" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:gearshift" /></ItemGrid> | 直线传递，通电时反转 |
| <ItemLink id="create:wrench" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:wrench" /></ItemGrid> | 旋转与配置已放置的动力部件 |

普通齿轮箱在拐角处让轴互为镜像方向，并行齿轮箱在拐角处同向。两者直线连接都会反转。

Create: Connected 提供针对具体路由的部件。

| 部件 | 外观 | 不同之处 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:cross_connector" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:cross_connector" /></ItemGrid> | 跨过中间传递旋转，两条线不相接 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:parallel_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:parallel_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | 拐角同向，直线反转 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:six_way_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:six_way_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | 六个面都能接轴 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brass_gearbox" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brass_gearbox" /></ItemGrid> | 每个面用扳手单独设置 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:encased_chain_cogwheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:encased_chain_cogwheel" /></ItemGrid> | 链条传动，本身也能接齿轮 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /></ItemGrid> | 在两条独立网络之间传递设定数量的容量，可在数值面板调整 |

***

## 保护线路的开关

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:clutch" /></ItemGrid> | 红石切断分支，来源继续转动 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inverted_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | 只有通电时才传递 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:inverted_gearshift" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:inverted_gearshift" /></ItemGrid> | 默认反转，通电时原样传递 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:freewheel_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:freewheel_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | 输入旋转符合设定方向时才传递动力 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:centrifugal_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:centrifugal_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | 按设定的输入转速阈值接合 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:shear_pin" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:shear_pin" /></ItemGrid> | 一次性连接件，网络过载时断裂 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:overstress_clutch" /></ItemGrid> | 过载持续到设定延迟后脱开，排除过载后用扳手或红石脉冲复位 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:brake" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brake" /></ItemGrid> | 收到红石信号时给网络施加很大的应力负载 |

***

## 手动与更大的来源

| 来源 | 外观 | 需要什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:crank_wheel" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:crank_wheel" /></ItemGrid> | 放在地上的轮子用手摇。按住右键逆时针，潜行时按住右键顺时针 |

风车轴承与蒸汽引擎的思索课程会展示对应的发电装置布局。研磨与矿石处理见[材料加工](machines.ore-processing.md)。

## Connect and move a first item

Hold <ItemLink id="create:belt_connector" /> and right click two shafts in a supported alignment to connect them. Rotate either shaft and both turn at the same speed and direction. Drop an item onto the moving belt. Empty-hand right click picks it up. Open these Ponder lessons: Using Mechanical Belts and Valid Orientations for Mechanical Belts.

| Part | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Belt | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /></ItemGrid> | Connects two shafts and carries items |
| Andesite Funnel | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:andesite_funnel" /></ItemGrid> | Transfers one item at a time |
| Brass Funnel | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /></ItemGrid> | Transfers up to a stack, with filter and amount panel |

Place a funnel normally to extract from an inventory, sneak-place to insert, then use a wrench to flip it. Redstone disables it. On belts, movement direction determines transfer direction. A brass filter slot accepts only matching stacks.

***

## Sort, drop and collect

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+Create+6+brass+tunnel+sorting+mechanical+arm+input+output+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B+6+%E9%BB%84%E9%93%9C%E9%9A%A7%E9%81%93+%E5%88%86%E6%8B%A3+%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E8%87%82+%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5+%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

| Part | View | Distinction |

| Andesite Tunnel | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:andesite_tunnel" /></ItemGrid> | Covers a belt and splits exactly one item off when side connections are present |
| Brass Tunnel | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_tunnel" /></ItemGrid> | Inbound filters reject non-matches. Outbound filters sort by item. Distribution modes choose among valid outputs. |

| Brass Chute | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:brass_chute" /></ItemGrid> | Use for the addon chute route shown in its item help |

For a chute, place it between the inventories. A wrench opens a side window. An encased fan at the top or bottom lets it move items upward. Goggles show the movement direction.

Assign a <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_arm" /> before placing it. Right click supported depots or funnels while holding the arm to add targets. Right click again changes blue input to yellow output, and left click removes a target. Then place and power the arm. Not every inventory is directly supported, so use a depot or funnel as an interface when needed. Brass funnel targets pass their filters to the arm.

## Packages and stock requests

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+Create+6+stock+network+packager+stock+link+stock+ticker+address+complete+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B+6+%E6%89%93%E5%8C%85%E6%9C%BA+%E5%BA%93%E5%AD%98%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5+%E5%BA%93%E5%AD%98%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E5%99%A8+%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80+%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

| Part | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Packager | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:packager" /></ItemGrid> | Packages items from its attached inventory under redstone, or unpacks a package inserted into it |
| Package Filter | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:package_filter" /></ItemGrid> | Routes by package address, not item contents |
| Package Frogport | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:package_frogport" /></ItemGrid> | Package delivery interface |
| Stock Link | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /></ItemGrid> | Lets stock-linked packagers expose their inventories to the network |
| Redstone Requester | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:redstone_requester" /></ItemGrid> | Requests stock through the network |

1. Attach a Packager to the source inventory. Put a few test items inside and pulse the packager with redstone. A package should appear. This tests packing before adding a network.
2. Transport that package on a belt into a destination Packager attached to a receiving inventory. It unpacks only when the inventory can accept the entire contents.
3. Attach a Stock Link to the source Packager. Hold another Stock Link and right click the first before placing it to join that network. The links share stock information, not the physical packages.
4. Hold a <ItemLink id="create:stock_ticker" /> and right click the Stock Link before placement. Put a seated creature or a Blaze Burner in front as its Stock Keeper, then right click that keeper to order available stock. For automated orders, bind a Redstone Requester to the same link before placing it, right click its interface to set an order, and pulse it.
5. Set the requested destination address and use a Package Filter for that address on the transport route. The test succeeds when the requested goods arrive and unpack in the intended inventory.

Attach a stock link to a packager and connect it to the network. A link on a vault alone does not display a count. The package still needs a transport route.

## 连接传送带并运送物品

手持 <ItemLink id="create:belt_connector" />，右键点击两个方向受支持的轴即可连接。转动任一轴，两者会以相同方向与转速转动。把物品丢上移动的传送带，空手右键可取下。Ponder 课程包括 Using Mechanical Belts 与 Valid Orientations for Mechanical Belts。

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 传送带 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /></ItemGrid> | 连接两根轴并运送物品 |
| 安山漏斗 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:andesite_funnel" /></ItemGrid> | 一次传送一件物品 |
| 黄铜漏斗 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /></ItemGrid> | 最多传送一整堆，带过滤与数量面板 |

普通放置漏斗会从库存取物，潜行放置会向库存送物，再用扳手翻转方向。红石信号会停用漏斗。在传送带上，传送带运动方向决定传输方向。黄铜过滤槽只接受匹配物品堆。

## 分拣、落料与收集

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+Create+6+brass+tunnel+sorting+mechanical+arm+input+output+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B+6+%E9%BB%84%E9%93%9C%E9%9A%A7%E9%81%93+%E5%88%86%E6%8B%A3+%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E8%87%82+%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5+%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

| 安山隧道 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:andesite_tunnel" /></ItemGrid> | 覆盖传送带，有侧面连接时恰好分出一件物品 |
| 黄铜隧道 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_tunnel" /></ItemGrid> | 输入过滤会挡住不匹配物，输出过滤按物品分拣，分配模式决定有效出口的选择 |

把滑槽放在两个库存之间，扳手可开侧窗。顶部或底部加鼓风风扇后可向上移动物品，护目镜会显示移动方向。

<ItemLink id="create:mechanical_arm" /> 必须先指定目标再放置。手持机械臂右键点击支持的压台或漏斗以添加目标，再次右键把蓝色输入切换成黄色输出，左键移除目标，然后放置并供能。并非所有库存都可直接交互，必要时用压台或漏斗作接口。黄铜漏斗目标会把过滤规则传给机械臂。

## 包裹与库存请求

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+Create+6+stock+network+packager+stock+link+stock+ticker+address+complete+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B+6+%E6%89%93%E5%8C%85%E6%9C%BA+%E5%BA%93%E5%AD%98%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5+%E5%BA%93%E5%AD%98%E6%8A%A5%E4%BB%B7%E5%99%A8+%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80+%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 打包机 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:packager" /></ItemGrid> | 红石信号下打包相连库存的物品，也会拆开投入其中的包裹 |
| 包裹过滤器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:package_filter" /></ItemGrid> | 按包裹地址分流，不按物品内容 |
| 包裹蛙港 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:package_frogport" /></ItemGrid> | 包裹投递接口 |
| 库存链接 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:stock_link" /></ItemGrid> | 让接入网络的打包机公开其库存 |
| 红石请求器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:redstone_requester" /></ItemGrid> | 通过网络请求库存 |

1. 将打包机装到供货库存上，放入少量测试物品，再给打包机一个红石脉冲。出现包裹就说明打包成功，先完成这一步再增加网络。
2. 用传送带把包裹送入另一台连接收货库存的打包机。只有收货库存能容纳整个包裹时才会拆包。
3. 在供货打包机上安装库存链接。手持另一个库存链接，放置前先右键第一个链接，就能加入同一网络。链接共享的是库存信息，不会传送实体包裹。
4. 手持 <ItemLink id="create:stock_ticker" />，放置前先右键库存链接以绑定网络。在报价器前放坐下的生物或烈焰燃烧器作为库存管理员，再右键管理员订购已有库存。自动订货时，红石请求器也要在放置前绑定同一链接，放置后右键打开界面设置订单，再发送脉冲。
5. 在订单中设置目标地址，并在运输路线上用包裹过滤器按地址分流。所订物品到达指定库存并成功拆包，就说明整条路线工作正常。

把库存链接接到打包机并连入网络。单独装在仓库上的链接不会显示数量。包裹仍需要运输路线。

## Vents under the sea

![Dormant vent](images/molten-vent-dormant.png)

In this pack, Molten Vents generate underwater. The dormant vent is an orestone formation with a magma-marked core inside. After activation, placing lava on the active core consumes that lava source and turns its location into the matching orestone. The vent does not create lava, and each conversion needs another lava source.

| Vent | View | What it makes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" /></ItemGrid> | Asurine orestone |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_veridium" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_veridium" /></ItemGrid> | Veridium orestone |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_crimsite" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_crimsite" /></ItemGrid> | Crimsite orestone |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /></ItemGrid> | Ochrum orestone |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_scorchia" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scorchia" /></ItemGrid> | Scorchia orestone |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_scoria" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scoria" /></ItemGrid> | Scoria orestone |

Each family has a dormant and an active block. The dormant form sits in the vent shell and does nothing, and the active form is the one that converts lava into stone.

***

## Wake a vent

1. Clear the inside of the vent until you reach the block that matches the surrounding orestone but carries magma.
2. Detonate TNT beside the magma-marked core so the blast reaches it.
3. Watch the magma brighten. The block is now active.

<GameScene zoom="3" interactive={true}>
<Block id="molten_vents:dormant_molten_asurine" />
<Block x="2" id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" />
</GameScene>

The dark core is dormant. The brighter core is active.

<ItemLink id="molten_vents:dormant_molten_asurine" />

Activation and supply: <ItemLink id="minecraft:tnt" /> and <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />.

| What you see | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| The blast does nothing | The block was plain orestone, not the magma core |
| The vent stays dark | The blast did not reach the core |
| Lava sits on a cold vent | The core was never activated |

Work with room to swim and a way to breathe, because the vents are underwater here.

***

## Lava in, stone out

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:hose_pulley" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /></ItemGrid>

Lava dropped onto an active vent is consumed and replaced by that vent's orestone, so a vent converts lava into building and crushing material rather than generating anything on its own.

| Supply | When it fits |
| --- | --- |
| Buckets by hand | Proving the vent works |
| <ItemLink id="create:hose_pulley" /> over a lava lake | A lava supply that must be replenished unless its body meets the hose pulley’s infinite-source rules |
| Pumped from a tank | You already move lava for fuel or casting |

After a successful conversion, collect the resulting orestone and replenish the lava source before repeating. Use a bucket to confirm the conversion before automating.

- [Material processing](machines.ore-processing.md) Crushing and washing the orestone.
- [Item and fluid routing](machines.logistics.md) Belts that carry the stone away.
- [Process heat](power.burners.md) Heat users that may want the lava instead.

## 海底的熔岩泉

![休眠熔岩泉](images/molten-vent-dormant.png)

在本整合包中，熔岩泉生成于水下。休眠泉是一片矿石构造，内部藏有表面带岩浆的核心。激活后，把熔岩放在激活核心上，该处熔岩源会被消耗并变成对应矿石。泉不会生成熔岩，每次转换都需要新的熔岩源。

| 泉 | 外观 | 产出 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" /></ItemGrid> | 阿斯瑞恩矿石 |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_veridium" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_veridium" /></ItemGrid> | 维瑞丁矿石 |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_crimsite" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_crimsite" /></ItemGrid> | 克里姆赛特矿石 |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_ochrum" /></ItemGrid> | 奥克鲁姆矿石 |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_scorchia" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scorchia" /></ItemGrid> | 斯科奇亚矿石 |
| <ItemLink id="molten_vents:active_molten_scoria" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="molten_vents:active_molten_scoria" /></ItemGrid> | 斯科利亚矿石 |

每一族都有休眠与激活两种方块。休眠形态在泉体外壳里，什么也不做，激活形态才会把熔岩变成石头。

***

## 激活熔岩泉

1. 清空泉体内部，直到找到与周围矿石相同、但表面带岩浆的那一块。
2. 在岩浆核心旁引爆 TNT，让爆炸触及核心。
3. 看岩浆变亮，这一块就激活了。

<GameScene zoom="3" interactive={true}>
<Block id="molten_vents:dormant_molten_asurine" />
<Block x="2" id="molten_vents:active_molten_asurine" />
</GameScene>

暗色核心处于休眠状态，更亮的核心已被激活。

<ItemLink id="molten_vents:dormant_molten_asurine" />

激活与供料：<ItemLink id="minecraft:tnt" />与<ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />.

| 看到的现象 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 爆炸毫无反应 | 炸的是普通矿石，不是岩浆核心 |
| 泉还是暗的 | 爆炸没有触及核心 |
| 熔岩停在冷泉上 | 核心从未被激活 |

这里的水下作业要留出游泳空间，并准备好呼吸手段。

***

## 进熔岩，出石头

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:hose_pulley" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /></ItemGrid>

把熔岩放到激活的泉上，熔岩会被消耗并替换成该泉的矿石，所以泉是把熔岩转换成建筑与粉碎材料的装置，本身不产生东西。

| 供料方式 | 适合什么情况 |
| --- | --- |
| 手提桶 | 验证泉是否工作 |
| 熔岩湖上的 <ItemLink id="create:hose_pulley" /> | 熔岩来源仍需补充，除非该流体体积满足软管滑轮的无限源规则 |
| 从储罐抽取 | 已经在为燃料或浇铸输送熔岩 |

转换成功后，收集生成的矿石，并补充熔岩源再重复操作。具体收集与补料布局取决于地点，建议先用桶确认转换成功，再考虑自动化。

- [材料加工](machines.ore-processing.md) 粉碎与清洗矿石。
- [物品与流体输送](machines.logistics.md) 把石头运走的传送带。
- [加工供热](power.burners.md) 可能也需要这些熔岩的热源。

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Molten+Vents+activate+underwater+vent+orestone+lava+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Molten+Vents+%E6%B5%B7%E5%BA%95%E7%86%94%E5%B2%A9%E6%B3%89+%E6%BF%80%E6%B4%BB+%E7%9F%BF%E7%9F%B3+%E5%B2%A9%E6%B5%86+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

machines.enchanting.en_us:
## Turn experience into liquid

Craft two <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /> items. Right click a placed Item Drain with one to turn it into a <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" />. Place the second Mechanical Grindstone on top, then connect the drain to a tank. Power the grindstone and insert experience items such as experience nuggets. The tank fills with Liquid Experience. Open the Ponder lesson Introduction to Mechanical Grindstone. This is not a general damaged-item experience source.

<Recipe id="create_enchantment_industry:crafting/mechanical_grindstone" />

| Part | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mechanical Grindstone | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /></ItemGrid> | Grinds experience items into fluid. Also supports manual sanding |
| Grindstone Drain | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" /></ItemGrid> | Collects the grindstone's Liquid Experience output |
| Item Drain | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:item_drain" /></ItemGrid> | Drains fluid from fluid-bearing items |
| Experience Hatch | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_hatch" /></ItemGrid> | Right click deposits player experience, shift right click withdraws. Panel sets amount |
| Experience Lantern | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_lantern" /></ItemGrid> | Absorbs nearby experience orbs and player experience. Glow indicates stored amount |

***

## Enchant, forge and print

| Machine | View | First operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blaze Enchanter | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_enchanter" /></ItemGrid> | Supply Liquid Experience and set the enchantment level. Hold the equipment type you want to use as the enchantment filter and right click the panel's filter slot to enter Template Enchanting Mode. Then insert a blank Enchanting Template. Only enchantments supported by that equipment type will be generated. Goggles show required inputs, cost, result or why it cannot start. |
| Blaze Forger | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger" /></ItemGrid> | Supply Liquid Experience and choose the side-panel mode. Merge compatible enchantments or templates, apply a template, or extract an enchantment into a blank template. Remove both outputs before another batch. |
| Printer | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:printer" /></ItemGrid> | Set a target item in its filter slot, then supply the matching fluid and materials for that print recipe. A concrete job is copying an enchanted book with its required Liquid Experience. |
| Enchanting Template | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:enchanting_template" /></ItemGrid> | Carries enchantments between supported operations |

The printer's filter selects what to print. The exact fluid and material are recipe-specific. The recipe browser gives that job's inputs. Forger mode changes through its side panel. Open these Ponder lessons: Introduction to Blaze Enchanter, Introduction to Blaze Forger and Introduction to Printer.

***

## Repair and manual tools

A spout supplied with Liquid Experience repairs passing gear that has Mending. Put the spout over a belt, fill it with the fluid, then send the item through. Reduced damage is the visible result.

| Tool | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spout | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:spout" /></ItemGrid> | Applies Liquid Experience to Mending gear on a belt |
| Belt | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /></ItemGrid> | Carries gear through the spout |
| Anvil | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:anvil" /></ItemGrid> | Manual repair and combination |
| Name Tag | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:name_tag" /></ItemGrid> | Manual naming. Easy Anvils changes its interface |
| Enchanted Book | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:enchanted_book" /></ItemGrid> | Manual enchantment source and printer job input |

- [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) Drive the grindstone and belt.
- [Item and fluid routing](machines.logistics.md) Feed and collect machine inputs.

***

## 把经验变成液体

制作两个 <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" />。手持其中一个右键已放置的物品排液口，将其变成 <ItemLink id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" />。再在上方放置第二个机械磨石，并连接通往储罐的流体路线。给磨石供能并投入经验物品，例如经验颗粒，储罐就会装入液体经验。Ponder 课程包括 Introduction to Mechanical Grindstone。这不是把任意受损物品变成经验的通用来源。

<Recipe id="create_enchantment_industry:crafting/mechanical_grindstone" />

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 机械磨石 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:mechanical_grindstone" /></ItemGrid> | 将经验物品磨成流体，也能手持打磨 |
| 磨石排液口 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:grindstone_drain" /></ItemGrid> | 收集磨石产出的液体经验 |
| 物品排液口 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:item_drain" /></ItemGrid> | 从含流体物品中排出流体 |
| 经验存取口 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_hatch" /></ItemGrid> | 右键存入玩家经验，蹲下右键取回，面板设定数量 |
| 经验灯 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:experience_lantern" /></ItemGrid> | 吸收附近经验球与玩家经验，亮度指示储量 |

***

## 附魔、锻造与打印

| 机器 | 外观 | 首次操作 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 烈焰附魔器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_enchanter" /></ItemGrid> | 供给液体经验并设置附魔等级。手持要用作筛选依据的装备，右键面板的过滤槽以进入模板附魔模式，再投入空白附魔模板。生成范围仅限于该装备类型支持的附魔。护目镜显示所需输入、消耗、结果或无法启动的原因。 |
| 烈焰锻造器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger" /></ItemGrid> | 供给液体经验并选择侧面面板模式。合并兼容附魔或模板、应用模板，或将附魔提取到空白模板。开始下一批前取走两件产物。 |
| 打印机 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:printer" /></ItemGrid> | 在过滤槽设定目标物品，再按打印配方供给对应流体与材料。一个实际用途是用所需液体经验复制附魔书。 |
| 附魔模板 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_enchantment_industry:enchanting_template" /></ItemGrid> | 在受支持的操作间转移附魔 |

打印机过滤槽选择打印对象。准确流体与材料取决于具体配方。用配方浏览器查看所选任务的输入。锻造模式在侧面面板切换。Ponder 课程包括 Introduction to Blaze Enchanter、Introduction to Blaze Forger 与 Introduction to Printer。

***

## 修理与手动工具

注液器接入液体经验后，会修理带经验修补的传送带装备。把注液器放在传送带上方，装入流体，再让物品通过。损伤减少就是可见结果。

| 工具 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 注液器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:spout" /></ItemGrid> | 在传送带上给经验修补装备注入液体经验 |
| 传送带 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:belt_connector" /></ItemGrid> | 将装备送过注液器 |
| 铁砧 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:anvil" /></ItemGrid> | 手动修理与合并 |
| 命名牌 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:name_tag" /></ItemGrid> | 手动命名。Easy Anvils 改变其界面 |
| 附魔书 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:enchanted_book" /></ItemGrid> | 手动附魔来源与打印任务输入 |

- [旋转动力](machines.rotation.md) 驱动磨石与传送带。
- [物品与流体输送](machines.logistics.md) 运送机器输入与产物。

## Connect a depot to a villager

Attach a <ItemLink id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /> to the workstation claimed by a villager. Open the depot and select an available trade with its trade filter, then supply the exact listed costs. The villager must be able to reach the workstation and work during normal work hours. Open the Ponder lesson Trading with trading depots.

<Recipe id="trading_floor:trading_depot" />

| Part | View | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trading Depot | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /></ItemGrid> | Holds that depot's input and output |
| Claimed workstation | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lectern" /></ItemGrid> | Connects the depot to its villager |
| Mechanical Arm | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_arm" /></ItemGrid> | Feeds supported trading-depot targets after configuration |
| Trade goods | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:emerald" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid> | Costs and results come from the selected villager offer |

When the villager next works, the depot performs the selected trade if its inputs are present. Check the depot information and last-trade field with goggles. Move the output from the depot with a funnel or chute.

***

## Trades with two inputs

Use two depots for a trade with two different costs. Set the trade filter on the first input depot to avoid unrelated offers. The second depot shares the trade when filters match, or when that other depot has no filter set. This means an unset filter, not an empty depot inventory. The output goes to the depot holding the first trade input.

| Route | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Single input | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /></ItemGrid> | Brass funnel feeds the exact selected cost |
| Vertical transfer | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:chute" /></ItemGrid> | Chute feeds or removes items vertically |
| Trade readout | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:display_link" /></ItemGrid> | Optional status display |

The villager owns its prices and restocking. Open the Ponder lesson Trading with multiple trading depots. [Item and fluid routing](machines.logistics.md) covers item movement.

***

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Trading+Floor+trading+depot+villager+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%9C%BA%E6%A2%B0%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B+%E4%BA%A4%E6%98%93%E7%AB%99+%E6%9D%91%E6%B0%91+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

## 将交易站连接到村民

把 <ItemLink id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /> 接到村民已认领的工作站。打开交易站，用交易过滤器选择一笔可用交易，再按列表放入准确成本物品。村民必须能到达工作站，并在正常工作时间工作。Ponder 课程包括 Trading with trading depots。

<Recipe id="trading_floor:trading_depot" />

| 部件 | 外观 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 交易站 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="trading_floor:trading_depot" /></ItemGrid> | 存放该交易站的输入与产物 |
| 已认领工作站 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lectern" /></ItemGrid> | 将交易站连接到对应村民 |
| 机械臂 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_arm" /></ItemGrid> | 配置后向受支持的交易站目标供料 |
| 交易物品 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:emerald" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid> | 成本与结果取决于所选村民报价 |

村民下次工作时，若输入齐全，交易站会执行选定交易。用护目镜查看交易站信息与最近交易栏。用漏斗或滑槽从交易站取出产物。

***

## 双输入交易

需要两种不同成本物品的交易要用两个交易站。在第一个输入站设置交易过滤器，避免误选其他报价。第二个交易站在过滤器相同，或该站未设置过滤器时，会参与交易。这里指过滤器未设置，不是交易站库存为空。产物进入持有第一项交易输入的交易站。

| 路线 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 单输入 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:brass_funnel" /></ItemGrid> | 黄铜漏斗供给选定的准确成本 |
| 竖直传输 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:chute" /></ItemGrid> | 滑槽竖直供料或取货 |
| 交易读数 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:display_link" /></ItemGrid> | 可选状态显示 |

村民决定价格与补货。Ponder 课程包括 Trading with multiple trading depots。[物品与流体输送](machines.logistics.md)介绍物品移动。

***

## Refill and use a portable tool

Fill a filling tank by right clicking a water source with it. Fueling tanks draw lava instead. Keep the filled tank in your inventory and the compatible tool in your main hand. Its fluid bar rises as it refills. Water and fuel use separate tank families.

| Tool | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Portable Drill | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:portable_drill" /></ItemGrid> | Hold it to mine blocks at high speed. It wears durability and is correct for drops except blocks tagged as requiring diamond tools |
| Grappling Whisk | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:grapplin_whisk" /></ItemGrid> | Right click to launch the hook. A hooked hand pose indicates attachment |
| Copper Magnet | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /></ItemGrid> | Hold in hand to attract nearby drops |
| Block Picker | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:block_picker" /></ItemGrid> | With water stored, right click a block with empty space above it to lift it. Spawners and blocks with hardness fifty or more cannot be lifted. Keep the picker selected to carry it. Right click empty air to release. It settles into a free destination or drops resources if blocked. Do not use this as a promise of safe transport for filled containers. |

The drill's progress and the grappling whisk's fuel bar make consumption visible. Filling tanks carry water, fueling tanks carry fuel. Small, medium and large sizes differ in capacity. These are portable refill items, not placed recharge stations.

***

## Tanks and engines

| Family | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Filling tanks | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:small_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:medium_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:large_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:creative_filling_tank" /></ItemGrid> | Carry water for tools |
| Fueling tanks | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:small_fueling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:medium_fueling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:large_fueling_tank" /></ItemGrid> | Carry accepted fuel for tools |
| Fixed steam engine | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid> | The Create boiler engine, distinct from portable engine components |
| Portable engines | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:steam_engine" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:hydraulic_engine" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:heat_engine" /></ItemGrid> | Select the engine matching the device. They are separate steam, hydraulic and heat variants |


***

## Deploy and control a drone

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:brass_drone_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:drone_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:brass_drill_head" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:fan_component" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:vault_component" /></ItemGrid>

1. Hold the Brass Drone in your main hand and right click a block's top face. The drone appears above it and belongs to you. Survival deployment consumes the item.
2. Right click the drone with an empty hand to pause or resume its movement. Hold the controller in either hand to guide your unpaused drone.
3. Press <KeyBind id="key.create_sa.increase_reach" /> to move its target farther along your line of sight, or <KeyBind id="key.create_sa.decrease_reach" /> to bring it closer. The defaults are the Up and Down keys. Press once per adjustment. Putting the controller away resets the reach and action.
4. Hold a Brass Drill Head, Copper Magnet, Fan Component or Vault Component and right click the drone to attach that enabled module. It appears on the drone and consumes one component outside creative mode.
5. Right click empty air with the controller to toggle the module action. For drilling, guide it above a breakable block and trigger the action. A removed block and drops confirm success. A successful drill action resets rather than continuing forever.

Right clicking the drone itself controls pausing, not the module action.

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Stuff+Additions+2.1.4+drone+controller+block+picker+guide) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+1.21.1+Create+Stuff+Additions+%E6%97%A0%E4%BA%BA%E6%9C%BA+%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%E5%99%A8+%E6%96%B9%E5%9D%97%E6%8B%BE%E5%8F%96%E5%99%A8+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

***

- [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) Fixed machine drives.

## 给便携工具补给并使用

手持装水储罐右键水源即可装水，加燃料储罐则从熔岩源补给。把装好的储罐留在物品栏中，主手拿兼容工具，工具流体条上升就表示正在补给。水和燃料使用不同的储罐系列。

| 工具 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 便携钻头 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:portable_drill" /></ItemGrid> | 手持高速挖掘方块，会消耗耐久。除需要钻石工具标签的方块外，可正确采集掉落 |
| 抓钩胡须 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:grapplin_whisk" /></ItemGrid> | 右键发射钩索，手臂呈拉弓姿势表示已钩住 |
| 铜磁铁 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /></ItemGrid> | 手持时吸引附近掉落物 |
| 方块拾取器 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:block_picker" /></ItemGrid> | 储有水时，右键上方为空气的方块将其举起。不能举起刷怪笼或硬度达到五十的方块。保持选中拾取器以搬运，对空气右键即可放下。落点空闲时恢复为方块，受阻时掉落资源。不要据此认为装有物品的容器可以安全搬运。 |

钻头挖掘进度与抓钩燃料条能显示消耗。装水储罐带水，加燃料储罐带燃料。小、中、大容量不同。这些是便携补给物品，不是放置后自动充能的机器。

***

## 储罐与引擎

| 家族 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 装水储罐 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:small_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:medium_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:large_filling_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:creative_filling_tank" /></ItemGrid> | 为工具携带水 |

| 固定蒸汽引擎 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:steam_engine" /></ItemGrid> | 机械动力的锅炉引擎，不是便携引擎组件 |
| 便携引擎 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:steam_engine" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:hydraulic_engine" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:heat_engine" /></ItemGrid> | 选择与设备匹配的引擎，分别是蒸汽、水力与热能变体 |

## 部署并控制无人机

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_sa:brass_drone_item" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:drone_controller" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:brass_drill_head" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:copper_magnet" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:fan_component" /><ItemIcon id="create_sa:vault_component" /></ItemGrid>

1. 主手拿黄铜无人机，右键方块顶面。无人机会出现在上方并归你所有，生存模式会消耗该物品。
2. 空手右键无人机可暂停或恢复移动。任意一只手拿控制器，即可引导属于你的未停驻无人机。
3. 按 <KeyBind id="key.create_sa.increase_reach" /> 将目标沿视线推远，按 <KeyBind id="key.create_sa.decrease_reach" /> 将目标拉近。默认分别是向上和向下方向键，每次调整要单独按一下。收起控制器会重置控制距离和动作状态。
4. 手持黄铜钻头、铜磁铁、风扇组件或仓库组件，右键无人机以安装已启用的对应模块。组件会出现在机身上，非创造模式会消耗一个。
5. 手持控制器对空气右键，切换模块动作。钻掘时先把无人机引导到可破坏方块上方，再触发动作。方块消失并掉落物品表示成功，成功钻掘后动作会重置，不会无限连续运行。

直接右键无人机切换的是停驻状态，不是模块动作。

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Stuff+Additions+2.1.4+drone+controller+block+picker+guide) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+1.21.1+Create+Stuff+Additions+%E6%97%A0%E4%BA%BA%E6%9C%BA+%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%E5%99%A8+%E6%96%B9%E5%9D%97%E6%8B%BE%E5%8F%96%E5%99%A8+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

***

- [材料加工](machines.ore-processing.md) 风扇介质与加工。
- [旋转动力](machines.rotation.md) 固定机器传动。

## Build the alternator

Create: Electro Energetics converts rotation to electricity at an alternator. In the Ponder lesson Setting up an alternator, surround the rotors with stators, then connect rotational drive.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_rotor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:stator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_brushes" /></ItemGrid>

For the physical arrangement, open the lesson rather than guessing the rotor and stator layout.

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+alternator+stator+rotor+setup) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+%E5%8F%91%E7%94%B5%E6%9C%BA+%E5%AE%9A%E5%AD%90+%E8%BD%AC%E5%AD%90+%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85)

***

## Close the first circuit

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:connector" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:copper_wire_spool" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:blue_electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:bulb" /></ItemGrid>

1. Place electrical connectors at the alternator output and at a bulb or blue electric motor.
2. Use the copper wire spool to connect alternator positive to the load, then connect the load return to alternator negative. Both legs are required for a closed circuit.
3. Start the rotation source. A lit bulb or turning motor is a direct first success.
4. Use Connecting Wires in Ponder to learn how to remove a wire with an empty spool.

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+closed+circuit+copper+wire+connectors+blue+electric+motor) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+%E9%97%AD%E5%90%88%E7%94%B5%E8%B7%AF+%E9%93%9C%E7%BA%BF+%E6%8E%A5%E7%BA%BF%E7%AB%AF+%E8%93%9D%E8%89%B2%E7%94%B5%E5%8A%A8%E6%9C%BA)

***

## Protect, measure, and transform

| Component | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse_holder" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:fuse_holder" /></ItemGrid> | Holds a protective fuse in series |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /></ItemGrid> | Connect in parallel across two points to read their voltage difference |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /></ItemGrid> | Insert in series to measure current |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:clamp_meter" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:clamp_meter" /></ItemGrid> | Right-click a wire to read current without breaking it |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:transformer_core" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer_core" /></ItemGrid> | Core for a configured transformer assembly |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /></ItemGrid> | High-voltage energy storage component |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /></ItemGrid> | Stores electrical energy, connect positive to positive and negative to negative |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /></ItemGrid> | Right-click to engage and open its internal switch, shift right-click to disengage |

The transformer core lesson requires radiator panels around the core and transformer oil over it to increase its power rating. Do not exceed that rating. A voltmeter reads between two points, not an absolute voltage at one point.

***

## Choose the next electrical component

After the first circuit works, add only the component your next job needs. A transformer changes voltage by its configured ratio. A regulator has separate source, ground and load terminals, so wiring it like a two-terminal bulb will not work.

| Part | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:fuse" /></ItemGrid> | Fit inside a Fuse Holder in the circuit path |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /></ItemGrid> | Insulated wiring material |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /></ItemGrid> | Electrical capacitor component |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /></ItemGrid> | Electric fluid-pumping machine |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:transformer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer" /></ItemGrid> | Set its ratio to step voltage up or down |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /></ItemGrid> | Source connects at the top input, negative at the bottom ground, load at the output, then close the return circuit |

***

## Supply the railway

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:catenary_holder" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:pantograph" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:rail_contact_shoe" /></ItemGrid>

For overhead supply, connect positive to the catenary and negative to a ground rod. An electric train needs its motor and a pantograph touching the catenary. A rail contact shoe is the selected Ponder's third-rail alternative. See [passenger rail](transport.passenger.md) for train operation.

- [Steel and oil](power.industry.md) for furnaces, oil processing and engines.

## 安装交流发电机

Create: Electro Energetics 在交流发电机处把旋转转换为电力。Ponder 条目 Setting up an alternator 要求用定子围住转子，再接入旋转动力。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_rotor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:stator" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:alternator_brushes" /></ItemGrid>

具体方块布局请打开该条目，不要猜测转子和定子位置。

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+alternator+stator+rotor+setup) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+%E5%8F%91%E7%94%B5%E6%9C%BA+%E5%AE%9A%E5%AD%90+%E8%BD%AC%E5%AD%90+%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85)

***

## 接通第一条电路

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:connector" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:copper_wire_spool" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:blue_electric_motor" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:bulb" /></ItemGrid>

1. 在交流发电机输出端与灯泡或蓝色电动机处放置电气接线端。
2. 用铜线轴把发电机正极接到负载，再把负载回路接回发电机负极。闭合电路需要两条线路。
3. 启动旋转动力源。灯泡亮起或电动机转动，就是直接可见的首次成功信号。
4. 通过 Connecting Wires Ponder 学习如何用空线轴拆除导线。

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+closed+circuit+copper+wire+connectors+blue+electric+motor) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+%E9%97%AD%E5%90%88%E7%94%B5%E8%B7%AF+%E9%93%9C%E7%BA%BF+%E6%8E%A5%E7%BA%BF%E7%AB%AF+%E8%93%9D%E8%89%B2%E7%94%B5%E5%8A%A8%E6%9C%BA)

***

## 保护、测量与变压

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse_holder" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:fuse_holder" /></ItemGrid> | 串联安装保险丝以保护电路 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltmeter" /></ItemGrid> | 并联接在两点之间，读取电压差 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:ammeter" /></ItemGrid> | 串联接入以测量电流 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:clamp_meter" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:clamp_meter" /></ItemGrid> | 右键点击导线测量电流，无需断线 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:transformer_core" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer_core" /></ItemGrid> | 变压器组装所需的铁芯 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:high_voltage_capacitor" /></ItemGrid> | 高压储能部件 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:accumulator" /></ItemGrid> | 储存电能，正极接正极，负极接负极 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:emergency_stop_button" /></ItemGrid> | 右键进入急停并断开内部开关，潜行右键则解除 |

变压器铁芯条目要求在铁芯周围安装散热板，并在上方覆盖变压器油以提高额定功率。不要超过额定值。电压表测量两点之间的电压差，不是单点的绝对电压。

***

## 选择下一项电气部件

第一条电路工作后，再按用途增加部件。变压器按设定变比改变电压。稳压器分为电源、接地和负载端子，不能像只有两个接点的灯泡那样连接。

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:fuse" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:fuse" /></ItemGrid> | 装入串联在电路中的保险丝座 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:insulated_wire" /></ItemGrid> | 绝缘导线材料 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:capacitor" /></ItemGrid> | 电容部件 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:electric_pump" /></ItemGrid> | 电动流体泵 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:transformer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:transformer" /></ItemGrid> | 设定变比以升压或降压 |
| <ItemLink id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:voltage_regulator" /></ItemGrid> | 电源接顶部输入端，负极接底部接地端，负载接输出端，再接通回路 |

***

## 为铁路供电

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:catenary_holder" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:pantograph" /><ItemIcon id="electroenergetics:rail_contact_shoe" /></ItemGrid>

架空供电时，正极接触网，负极接地线杆。电动列车需要电动机，并让受电弓接触接触网。所选 Ponder 也展示了第三轨接触靴方案。列车操作见[客运铁路](transport.passenger.md)。

- [钢铁与石油](power.industry.md)，了解炉子、石油加工与引擎。

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+electricity+guide) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+Create+Electro+Energetics+1.1.3+%E7%94%B5%E5%8A%9B%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

power.industry.en_us:
## Make coke first

The Coke Oven Ponder shows coal inserted from any side. Carbon dioxide exits at the top, creosote can be extracted from another face, and coal coke eventually falls from the machine. Use a row of ovens when the slow output must scale.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coke_oven" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coal_coke" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:creosote_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

<Recipe id="tfmg:crafting/materials/coke_oven" />

<ItemLink id="minecraft:coal" /> is the coke oven input.

***

## Build a working blast furnace

The Blast Furnace Ponder describes a fireproof-brick cylinder with a blast-furnace output and a hatch. Reinforcements are required for operation, not merely a speed upgrade. Insert material through the opening at the top. Use the hatch for the hot-air input. A second hatch at the top can collect furnace gas, with inserted items falling into the furnace.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:fireproof_bricks" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_hatch" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_stove" /></ItemGrid>

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+blast+furnace+reinforcement+hot+air) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+%E9%AB%98%E7%82%89+%E5%BC%BA%E5%8C%96+%E7%83%AD%E9%A3%8E)

The Blast Stove Ponder assigns its faces: fuel enters from below, air from the side, and hot air exits above. Carbon dioxide accumulates and can stall the stove, so route it to a nearby smokestack or exhaust. Confirm hot air reaches the furnace before feeding an iron batch.

***

## Find oil and distill it

Power the Surface Scanner from below with a Machine Input. Its top grid represents nearby chunks, with the current chunk at the centre. Chunks containing an oil deposit should light within seconds. Use chunk borders to identify the target.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:surface_scanner" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:pumpjack_base" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

The Pumpjack Ponder route begins with industrial pipe from the deposit to the surface. Put the pumpjack base on that pipe, place the hammer holder behind it, assemble the connector and head over the crank and base, join the hammer parts, and super glue the assembly. Finish with a Machine Input and crank above it to provide drive.

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+pumpjack+crude+oil+distillation+tower) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+%E6%8A%BD%E6%B2%B9%E6%9C%BA+%E5%8E%9F%E6%B2%B9+%E8%92%B8%E9%A6%8F%E5%A1%94)

For the distillation tower, assemble steel tanks as the base, place the Steel Distillation Controller beside them, then add up to six Distillation Outputs with industrial pipes between them. Put a heat source below the tanks, feed oil into the controller, and use the tower dial to confirm power. Outputs leave through the Distillation Outputs and pipes.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_controller" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

***

## Choose a process attachment

The Chemical Vat takes attachments that change its job. Insert the mixer blade for mixing. Two electrode holders with copper electrodes make an electrolyzer. Three graphite electrodes make a blast furnace. Some recipes require heating.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_chemical_vat" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_mixer" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:copper_electrode" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:graphite_electrode" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:casting_basin" /></ItemGrid>

For metal casting, supply molten steel to the casting basin and leave enough output space, since its internal storage is limited.

***

## Operate engines and winding machines

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+TFMG+Community+1.3.2a+regular+engine+turbine+engine+setup) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+1.21.1+TFMG+%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E+%E6%B6%A1%E8%BD%AE%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E+%E5%BB%BA%E9%80%A0+%E7%87%83%E6%96%99+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

A regular engine is assembled by the Ponder, its type cycles with an empty schematic, and matching cylinders complete it. Clicking the assembled engine with a shaft creates its kinetic output. Use the tutorial links above for the regular and turbine layouts. Their fuel and connections are not interchangeable with the large engine.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:regular_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:radial_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:turbine_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:large_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:simple_large_engine" /></ItemGrid>

Large engines require a shaft output, fuel from the side, continuous air, and carbon dioxide exhaust. Use the engine tooltip to confirm supported fuel for the particular engine.

The Winding Machine takes a spool by right-click, then an input item by right-click to place it. Supply rotation. Winding starts and stops when complete. Funnels insert input items and extract outputs, while deployers insert spools.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:winding_machine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:empty_spool" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:machine_input" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:engine_cylinder" /></ItemGrid>

***

## Wire the industrial workshop

Drive a generator from your shaft network, connect an industrial consumer through the matching cable system, then use the Configuration Wrench on electrical blocks to assign groups. Components sharing a group split voltage. Separate groups retain the full voltage. A motor turning is the first useful result. The transformer, potentiometer and switch create subnetworks, so use their own Ponder entries before expanding the circuit.

| Part | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:generator" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:generator" /></ItemGrid> | Converts shaft rotation into industrial electricity |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:electric_motor" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:electric_motor" /></ItemGrid> | Converts industrial electricity into rotation |
| <ItemLink id="tfmg:heavy_electric_motor" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:heavy_electric_motor" /></ItemGrid> | Heavy electric-motor family |

power.industry.zh_cn:
## 先制焦炭

Coke Oven Ponder 展示从任意侧面加入煤。二氧化碳从顶部排出，木馏油可从其他面抽取，煤焦炭会在一段时间后从机器掉出。需要提高产量时可并排布置多台焦炭炉。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coke_oven" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:coal_coke" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:creosote_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

<Recipe id="tfmg:crafting/materials/coke_oven" />

焦炭炉的原料是 <ItemLink id="minecraft:coal" />。

***

## 建造可工作的高炉

Blast Furnace Ponder 展示用耐火砖围成圆柱，并安装高炉输出方块与舱口。高炉必须有强化方块才能工作，强化并非仅用于提速。物料从顶部开口加入，舱口接入热风。顶部还可安装第二个舱口收集炉气，投入其中的物品会落入高炉。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:fireproof_bricks" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_furnace_hatch" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:blast_stove" /></ItemGrid>

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+blast+furnace+reinforcement+hot+air) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+%E9%AB%98%E7%82%89+%E5%BC%BA%E5%8C%96+%E7%83%AD%E9%A3%8E)

Blast Stove Ponder 明确了各面用途：底部输入燃料，侧面输入空气，顶部输出热风。二氧化碳会积累并可能使炉子停工，因此要把它排到附近的烟囱或排气口。先确认热风送达高炉，再投入铁料。

***

## 寻找石油并蒸馏

从底部用 Machine Input 为地表扫描器供能。顶部网格代表周围区块，中心格是所在区块。含油区块会在数秒内亮起，用区块边界确认目标位置。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:surface_scanner" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:pumpjack_base" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

Pumpjack Ponder 的路线从油藏铺设工业管道到地表开始。把抽油机底座放在管道顶端，后方放锤架，在曲柄与底座上方安装连接件和机头，用抽油机锤部件连接并涂抹超级胶水固定。最后安装 Machine Input，并在其上方放置曲柄提供动力。

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+pumpjack+crude+oil+distillation+tower) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=The+Factory+Must+Grow+Community+1.3.2a+%E6%8A%BD%E6%B2%B9%E6%9C%BA+%E5%8E%9F%E6%B2%B9+%E8%92%B8%E9%A6%8F%E5%A1%94)

蒸馏塔底部用钢制储罐组装，在储罐旁安装钢制蒸馏控制器，再加最多六个蒸馏输出口，并在它们之间连接工业管道。储罐下方放置热源，原油输入控制器，通过塔身刻度确认供能。产物经蒸馏输出口和管道导出。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_controller" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_distillation_output" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_pipe" /></ItemGrid>

***

## 选择加工附件

化学槽可安装不同附件来改变用途。插入搅拌叶片后用于搅拌。两个电极架配铜电极可组成电解器。三个石墨电极可组成高炉。部分配方需要加热。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:steel_chemical_vat" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:industrial_mixer" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:copper_electrode" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:graphite_electrode" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:casting_basin" /></ItemGrid>

铸造时将钢水送入铸造盆，并为产物留出足够空间，因为盆内储量有限。

***

## 操作引擎与绕线机

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+TFMG+Community+1.3.2a+regular+engine+turbine+engine+setup) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+1.21.1+TFMG+%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E+%E6%B6%A1%E8%BD%AE%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E+%E5%BB%BA%E9%80%A0+%E7%87%83%E6%96%99+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

Ponder 展示常规引擎的组装方式，用空白蓝图切换型号，插入同型号气缸后完成组装。对组装完成的引擎使用传动轴即可建立旋转输出。常规引擎和涡轮引擎的布局可查阅上方对应教程，燃料与连接方式不能直接照搬大型引擎。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:regular_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:radial_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:turbine_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:large_engine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:simple_large_engine" /></ItemGrid>

大型引擎需要传动轴输出、从侧面输入燃料、持续供气并排出二氧化碳。具体引擎可用燃料以该引擎的提示为准。

绕线机先用右键放入线轴，再右键放入待加工物品。提供旋转后开始绕线，完成时自动停止。漏斗可输入原料并取出成品，机械手可装入线轴。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="tfmg:winding_machine" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:empty_spool" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:machine_input" /><ItemIcon id="tfmg:engine_cylinder" /></ItemGrid>

## 连接工业工坊电网

用传动轴驱动发电机，通过对应电缆系统连接工业用电设备，再用设置扳手右键电气方块分配组别。同组部件分配电压，不同组保留完整电压。电动机开始转动就是首次有效结果。变压器、电位器和开关会建立子网络，扩建前先查看各自的 Ponder 条目。

## Heat for the machine above

<GameScene zoom="3" interactive={true}>
<Block id="create:blaze_burner" />
<Block y="1" id="create:basin" />
</GameScene>

A basin sits directly above its burner. This shows the heat connection, not a complete mixing machine.

A <ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> supplies heat to the block directly above it. Heat is not shaft rotation or electricity. Craft an <ItemLink id="create:empty_blaze_burner" />, then right-click a Blaze with it to capture the Blaze, or use the Blaze spawner. The burner can then be placed beneath a heat-using machine.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/empty_blaze_burner" />

| State or input | View | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Empty cage | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:empty_blaze_burner" /></ItemGrid> | No heat |
| Captured Blaze | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /></ItemGrid> | Ordinary heat when fueled |
| <ItemLink id="create:blaze_cake" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_cake" /></ItemGrid> | Superheated heat |

The burner state changes when it is working. Check the visible burner state and the machine above it, rather than inferring heat from a shaft turning.

***

## Feed it by hand or pipe

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /></ItemGrid>

1. For a manual start, right-click the burner with a flammable item. To superheat, feed it a Blaze Cake.
2. For automated item feeding, use a Deployer or Mechanical Arm. A hopper or dropped item is not the documented feed method.
3. For fluid, connect a tank and burner with pipes, then drive a mechanical pump in the direction of the burner.

Lava supplies ordinary heat. Start the fluid route with lava. Fuel compatibility is specific to the burner and fuel form, so do not substitute another liquid merely because it burns in an industrial engine.

- [Steel and oil](power.industry.md) Coke, steel, oil processing and engines.
- [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) The separate shaft network.

<GameScene zoom="3" interactive={true}>
<Block id="create:blaze_burner" />
<Block y="1" id="create:basin" />
</GameScene>

工作盆位于燃烧器正上方。图中只展示供热位置，不是完整的搅拌装置。

<ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> 为正上方的方块供热。热不是传动轴旋转，也不是电。先合成 <ItemLink id="create:empty_blaze_burner" />，再手持空燃烧器右键烈焰人捕获它，或使用烈焰人刷怪笼。之后把燃烧器放在需要热量的机器下方。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/empty_blaze_burner" />

## 手动或管道供料

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:blaze_burner" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" /><ItemIcon id="create:fluid_pipe" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_pump" /></ItemGrid>

1. 手动启动时，手持可燃物品右键燃烧器。要超级加热则喂入烈焰蛋糕。
2. 自动送入物品时用机械手或机械臂。漏斗或丢落物品不是文档记载的供料方式。
3. 输送流体时，用管道连接储罐与燃烧器，再驱动机械泵朝燃烧器方向抽送。

熔岩提供普通热。流体供料先从熔岩开始。燃料兼容性取决于燃烧器和燃料形态，不要因为另一种液体能在工业引擎中燃烧，就直接拿来替代。

power.stored-rotation.en_us:
## Rotational reserves

<ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> stores stress capacity. Unpowered, it draws stress from the front input to charge. Redstone makes it discharge at its set capacity and speed. Its interface and comparator output show charge. Other kinetic sources meeting demand prevent battery discharge apart from the small belt transport cost documented in its Ponder.

| Part | View | Job |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /></ItemGrid> | Stores and returns stress capacity |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /></ItemGrid> | Transfers capacity between separate networks |
| <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /></ItemGrid> | Reads network stress |
| <ItemLink id="create:analog_lever" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:analog_lever" /></ItemGrid> | Redstone control |

1. Connect an operating source to the battery front and leave it unpowered to charge.
2. Apply redstone to discharge. Compare the stored charge and network behavior.
3. To move charge between units, right-click a charging battery with another battery to discharge it, or right-click a discharging battery with a charged one to transfer charge. Deployers and mechanical arms automate this.

Batteries retain charge as items. Chain batteries to extend discharge duration. Connect them in parallel to raise total stress capacity. Actual drain follows the stress capacity in use, so do not treat the battery as a fixed-time supply.

***

## Springs store rotational force

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Springs+1.2+spring+charging+large+spring+tools+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+1.21.1+Create+Springs+%E5%BC%B9%E7%B0%A7+%E5%85%85%E8%83%BD+%E5%A4%A7%E5%9E%8B%E5%BC%B9%E7%B0%A7+%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

A spring stores rotational force. Either input direction charges it. Redstone releases the stored force, and signal strength controls output speed. Stiffness controls charging. The spring can switch between rotational output and splash mode with a Tripwire Hook, then return to rotational mode by using an empty hand.

| Spring system | View | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring" /></ItemGrid> | Charges from rotation, redstone discharges |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /></ItemGrid> | Build a large spring from same-facing coils, a three by three end layer and hollow rings |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:kinetic_interface" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:kinetic_interface" /></ItemGrid> | Paired interfaces with one-block gap interact with springs on a moving contraption |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_base" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_base" /></ItemGrid> | Base for spring-powered tools |

| Spring device | View | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_catapult" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_catapult" /></ItemGrid> | Select target before placement, insert items and supply rotation. Without a target it does nothing |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_drill" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_drill" /></ItemGrid> | Spring-powered drilling tool |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_saw" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_saw" /></ItemGrid> | Spring-powered cutting tool |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_shove" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_shove" /></ItemGrid> | Spring-powered digging tool |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_fan" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_fan" /></ItemGrid> | Spring-powered portable fan |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_launcher" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_launcher" /></ItemGrid> | Launcher for spring items and blocks |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:punchcard" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:punchcard" /></ItemGrid> | Programs supported tools |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:portative_steam_engine" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:portative_steam_engine" /></ItemGrid> | Portable steam engine with fuel, water and pressure controls |

1. Attach a spring to an operating shaft without a redstone signal. Either rotational direction charges it. Apply redstone to release its stored rotation, using signal strength to choose output speed.
2. For a portable tool, stack charged springs onto its Spring Base or supported spring tool in the inventory. The base and drill, saw, shovel and fan each accept up to two springs. Mining or harvesting speed follows the tool's speed.
3. Sneak right click a Punchcard to open its instructions, select the executor and activation condition, then stack the card onto the compatible tool. It programs actions, not charge.
4. Sneak right click with the Spring Catapult to select a target before placing it. Then supply rotation and insert an item. No selected target means no launch.

The Portable Steam Engine opens its interface with its configured engine-interface key. Put furnace fuel in its fuel slot and carry a water bucket for replenishment. Its mode chooses the supported charging or tool-speed job. Overdrive increases pressure and the engine explodes at one hundred pressure, so watch its gauge rather than leaving overdrive enabled.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:friction_welder" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_alloy" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:unfinished_spring" /></ItemGrid>

A Friction Welder processes blocks between two welders rotating with a speed difference. Use the recipe browser for the spring-alloy and unfinished-spring recipes rather than treating these materials as charged tools.

The punchcard configures supported tool instructions, not stored rotational force. The portable steam engine is a separate carried engine, not a spring. See [Rotational power](machines.rotation.md) for shafts and network stress.

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Springs+rotational+spring+kinetic+battery+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Springs+%E6%97%8B%E8%BD%AC%E5%BC%B9%E7%B0%A7+%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B%E7%94%B5%E6%B1%A0+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

## 旋转储备

<ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> 储存应力容量。未通红石时，它从正面输入抽取应力充能。接入红石后，它按设定的容量与转速放电。界面与比较器可读充能。其他动力源满足需求时，电池不会放电，但电池运输物品的传送带仍有少量消耗，这是其 Ponder 中说明的情况。

| 部件 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_battery" /></ItemGrid> | 储存并输出应力容量 |
| <ItemLink id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_connected:kinetic_bridge" /></ItemGrid> | 在独立网络之间传递容量 |
| <ItemLink id="create:stressometer" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:stressometer" /></ItemGrid> | 读取网络应力 |
| <ItemLink id="create:analog_lever" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:analog_lever" /></ItemGrid> | 红石控制 |

1. 把电池正面接到正在运行的动力源，保持未通红石以充能。
2. 接入红石放电，对比储能与网络运行情况。
3. 要在电池间转移电量，给正在充能的电池右键另一块电池以使其放电，或给正在放电的电池右键已充能电池来转移电量。机械手与机械臂可自动操作。

电池作为物品时也会保留电量。串联电池可延长放电时间，并联则提高总应力容量。实际消耗取决于正在使用的应力容量，不要把电池当作固定时长的电源。

***

## 弹簧储存旋转动力

![Tutorial](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Springs+1.2+spring+charging+large+spring+tools+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C+1.21.1+Create+Springs+%E5%BC%B9%E7%B0%A7+%E5%85%85%E8%83%BD+%E5%A4%A7%E5%9E%8B%E5%BC%B9%E7%B0%A7+%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

弹簧储存旋转动力。任一输入方向都能为它充能。红石会释放储存的动力，信号强度控制输出转速，刚度控制充能。用绊线钩可在旋转输出与飞溅模式之间切换，空手使用会切回旋转模式。

| 弹簧系统 | 外观 | 操作 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring" /></ItemGrid> | 由旋转充能，红石放电 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:large_spring_coil" /></ItemGrid> | 大弹簧由同向线圈组成，端面为三乘三，内部再加空心环 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:kinetic_interface" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:kinetic_interface" /></ItemGrid> | 一对接口相隔一格，可操作移动结构上的弹簧 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_base" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_base" /></ItemGrid> | 弹簧动力工具的底座 |

| 弹簧装置 | 外观 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_catapult" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_catapult" /></ItemGrid> | 放置前选好目标，放入物品并供旋转。没有目标时不会工作 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_drill" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_drill" /></ItemGrid> | 弹簧动力钻具 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_saw" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_saw" /></ItemGrid> | 弹簧动力锯具 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_shove" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_shove" /></ItemGrid> | 弹簧动力铲具 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_fan" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_fan" /></ItemGrid> | 弹簧动力便携风扇 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:spring_launcher" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_launcher" /></ItemGrid> | 发射弹簧物品与方块 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:punchcard" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:punchcard" /></ItemGrid> | 为支持的工具编程 |
| <ItemLink id="createsprings:portative_steam_engine" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:portative_steam_engine" /></ItemGrid> | 带燃料、水与压力控制的便携蒸汽引擎 |

1. 将弹簧接到正在运转的轴上，先不要接入红石。两个旋转方向都能充能。接入红石后释放储存的旋转动力，信号强度决定输出转速。
2. 制作便携工具时，在物品栏中把已充能弹簧叠放到弹簧底座或支持的弹簧工具上。底座、钻头、锯、铲和风扇都最多容纳两根弹簧。挖掘或采集速度取决于工具转速。
3. 潜行右键穿孔卡以打开指令界面，选择执行工具和触发条件，再把卡叠放到兼容工具上。它负责动作编程，不负责储能。
4. 手持弹簧弹射器潜行右键选定目标，再放置、提供旋转动力并投入物品。没有选定目标时不会发射。

便携蒸汽引擎的界面由当前绑定的引擎界面按键打开。将熔炉燃料放入燃料槽，并随身携带水桶以补充水。模式决定支持的充能或工具加速功能。超速模式会增加压力，压力达到一百时引擎会爆炸，因此要观察压力表，不要一直开启超速。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="createsprings:friction_welder" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:spring_alloy" /><ItemIcon id="createsprings:unfinished_spring" /></ItemGrid>

摩擦焊接器通过两台焊接器之间的转速差加工中间的方块。弹簧合金和未完成弹簧的配方可在配方浏览器中查询，不要把这些原料当成已充能工具。

穿孔卡配置支持工具的操作指令，不储存旋转动力。便携蒸汽引擎是独立的随身引擎，不是弹簧。轴与网络应力见[旋转动力](machines.rotation.md)。

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Springs+rotational+spring+kinetic+battery+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Create+Springs+%E6%97%8B%E8%BD%AC%E5%BC%B9%E7%B0%A7+%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B%E7%94%B5%E6%B1%A0+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)
