performance.baseline.en_us:
## Rendering

These components reduce rendering work in different parts of the client. They are not additional visual effects.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sodium | Replaces the terrain rendering engine. |
| ImmediatelyFast | Optimizes immediate-mode rendering. |
| Entity Culling | Avoids rendering hidden entities and block entities. |
| More Culling | Skips selected hidden rendering faces. |
| Cull Leaves | Skips selected hidden leaf geometry. |
| Flerovium | Optimizes item, particle and entity rendering. |
| AsyncParticles | Particle processing and rendering optimization. |
| Kerria | Accelerates animated texture processing. |
| CreateBetterFps | Create rendering optimization for shader use. |

***

## Simulation & terrain

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine spreads chunk work across processor threads. Fast Noise optimizes the noise calculations used in terrain generation. Both work in the background without special launch arguments or graphics acceleration. They do not increase render distance or regenerate explored terrain.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Lithium | Optimizes game logic in single-player and servers. |
| AI Improvements: Performance Tuning | Vanilla creature behavior optimization. |
| Clumps | Combines experience orbs to reduce separate orb processing. |
| Let Me Despawn | Adjusts creature despawn rules to reduce unintended persistent creatures. |
| Create: LazyTick | Create machine tick optimization. |
| Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (NeoForge) | Chunk management and generation optimization. |
| Fast Noise | Optimizes processor-side terrain noise calculations. |
| Structure Layout Optimizer | Optimizes jigsaw structure layout processing. |

***

## Memory & loading

Memory, loading and general fixes address different costs from terrain rendering.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| FerriteCore | Reduces memory use. |
| ModernFix | Performance, memory and bug-fix changes. |
| quick pack | Accelerates compressed data-pack and resource-pack loading. |
| BadOptimizations | Optimizations outside the main terrain renderer. |

***

## Input & idle use

Input processing and background resource use are separate from active-world simulation. Optimization support does not establish a measured frame-rate gain on your computer.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Ixeris | Buffered raw input and threaded event polling. |
| Dynamic FPS | Reduces resource use in the background or while idle. |

***

## Shared optimizers

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Async Logger | Processes logging asynchronously. |
| Jasione | Reduces repeated enumeration-array allocations. |
| ServerCore | Optimizes server processing, including the integrated single-player server. |

***

## Related topics

- [Diagnostics](server.tools.md)
- [Lighting & distance](visuals.lighting.md)
performance.baseline.zh_cn:
## 渲染

这些组件减少客户端不同部分的渲染工作，并不是额外视觉效果。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Sodium | 替换地形渲染引擎。 |
| ImmediatelyFast | 优化即时模式渲染。 |
| Entity Culling | 避免渲染被遮挡的实体与方块实体。 |
| More Culling | 跳过部分不可见的渲染面。 |
| Cull Leaves | 跳过部分不可见的树叶几何面。 |
| Flerovium | 优化物品、粒子与实体渲染。 |
| AsyncParticles | 优化粒子运算与渲染。 |
| Kerria | 加速动态纹理处理。 |
| CreateBetterFps | 优化使用光影时的机械动力渲染。 |

***

## 模拟与地形

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine 将区块工作分配给多个处理器线程，Fast Noise 优化地形生成使用的噪声计算。两者在后台工作，无需特殊启动参数或图形加速，也不会增加渲染距离或重新生成已探索地形。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Lithium | 优化单人游戏与服务器的游戏逻辑。 |
| AI Improvements: Performance Tuning | 优化原版生物行为处理。 |
| Clumps | 合并经验球，减少独立经验球的处理。 |
| Let Me Despawn | 调整生物消失规则，减少意外永久保留的生物。 |
| Create: LazyTick | 优化机械动力机器的刻处理。 |
| Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (NeoForge) | 优化区块管理与生成。 |
| Fast Noise | 优化处理器端的地形噪声计算。 |
| Structure Layout Optimizer | 优化拼图结构布局处理。 |

***

## 内存与加载

内存、加载与通用修复处理的开销不同于地形渲染。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| FerriteCore | 减少内存占用。 |
| ModernFix | 提供性能、内存与错误修复改进。 |
| quick pack | 加速压缩数据包与资源包加载。 |
| BadOptimizations | 优化主地形渲染器以外的处理。 |

***

## 输入与空闲

输入处理与后台资源使用不同于活动世界模拟。性能优化支持不代表已经测得你的电脑能提升多少帧率。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Ixeris | 提供缓冲原始输入与独立线程事件轮询。 |
| Dynamic FPS | 降低后台或空闲时的资源使用。 |

***

## 共用优化模组

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Async Logger | 异步处理日志。 |
| Jasione | 减少重复的枚举数组分配。 |
| ServerCore | 优化服务器处理，包括单人游戏的内置服务器。 |

***

## 相关页面

- [光照与远景](visuals.lighting.md)

server.tools.en_us:
## Dimension borders

DimWorldBorder gives each dimension its own border size and center, including the integrated server in single-player. Multiplayer players follow the server border without needing the mod on their client.

Operators can check a border before changing it.

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld get</Color> | Read the Overworld border |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:the_nether get</Color> | Read the Nether border |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder rocketnautics:moon get</Color> | Read the Moon border |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld set 5000</Color> | Set the Overworld square to a full width of 5000 blocks |

Use command completion to select a dimension. The packaged safety data pack also applies an Overworld limit when it loads. Check border values after a restart or data-pack reload before relying on a custom size. A player boundary does not guarantee that it contains an entire moving ship.

***

## Terrain preparation

Chunky generates terrain before players explore it. This is an administrator workload, not a rendering-distance setting. Large generation jobs consume processing time and disk space.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Chunky | Generates terrain ahead of exploration. |

***

## Diagnostics

Observable and spark identify processing costs. Client rendering and server simulation are different workloads. A server recording does not measure shader rendering cost. Access can depend on server permissions.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Observable | Identifies expensive server processing. |
| spark | Profiles client and server performance. |

***

## Pack defaults

Configured Defaults provides initial files when they are missing. Existing player choices are not the same as the packaged defaults. It is a pack-maintenance utility, not a performance profiler.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Configured Defaults | Supplies packaged defaults for missing files. |

***

## Related topics

- [Optimization](performance.baseline.md)
server.tools.zh_cn:
## 维度边界

DimWorldBorder 让各维度拥有独立的边界大小与中心，单人游戏的内置服务器也适用。多人游戏中，玩家遵循服务器边界，客户端无需安装此模组。

管理员应先查询边界，再修改设置。

| 命令 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld get</Color> | 查询主世界边界 |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:the_nether get</Color> | 查询下界边界 |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder rocketnautics:moon get</Color> | 查询月球边界 |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld set 5000</Color> | 将主世界方形边界的完整宽度设为 5000 格 |

使用命令补全选择维度。整合包的安全数据包也会在加载时设置主世界范围限制。自定义大小后，应在重启或重载数据包后查询边界值。玩家边界不保证能容纳或阻挡整艘移动船体。

***

## 地形准备

Chunky 在玩家探索前生成地形。这是管理员任务，不是渲染距离设置。大型生成任务会占用处理时间与磁盘空间。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Chunky | 在探索前预先生成地形。 |

***

## 诊断工具

Observable 与 spark 用于定位处理开销。客户端渲染与服务器模拟是不同工作负载。服务器记录不能衡量光影渲染开销，使用权限可能由服务器决定。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Observable | 用于定位服务器耗时处理。 |
| spark | 分析客户端与服务器性能。 |

***

## 整合包默认设置

Configured Defaults 在文件缺失时提供初始文件。已有玩家设置与整合包默认值并不相同。它是整合包维护工具，不是性能分析器。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Configured Defaults | 为缺失文件提供整合包默认设置。 |

***

## 相关页面

- [性能优化](performance.baseline.md)

technical.bridges.en_us:
## Equipment on ships

The Create Stuff 'N Additions Sable and Aeronautics compatibility addon adapts that equipment to moving ships. It is a compatibility layer, not a new vehicle family. Use the equipment's own recipes and controls, and do not assume it makes every interaction on a moving build interchangeable with a stationary one.

***

## Moving structures

Sable: Physics Compat supplies block physics properties. Sable Beyond extends moving-structure behavior. Neither is a catalogue of craftable vehicles. Compatibility support does not mean every block interaction works on a moving build.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sable: Physics Compat | Adds physics property tags to supported modded blocks. |
| Sable Beyond | Extends moving-structure behavior and compatibility. |

***

## Automatic fixes

AttributeFix repairs attribute limits. Neo Bee Fix repairs bee behavior. These run as supporting fixes rather than administrator tools or crafting systems.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| AttributeFix | Removes arbitrary attribute limits for mod compatibility. |
| Neo Bee Fix | Repairs vanilla bee behavior. |

***

## Feature bridges

Sound and animation bridges are listed with the feature they change. Shared frameworks remain in Libraries.

***

technical.bridges.zh_cn:
## 船上装备

Create Stuff 'N Additions 的 Sable 与 Aeronautics 兼容组件让对应装备适配移动船体。它是兼容层，并非新的载具系列。使用装备本身的配方与操作，不要假定它让移动建筑上的每种交互都与静止建筑完全相同。

***

## 移动结构

Sable: Physics Compat 补充方块物理属性，Sable Beyond 扩展移动结构行为。两者都不是可制作载具目录。兼容支持不代表移动建筑上的每种方块交互都能正常运作。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Sable: Physics Compat | 为受支持的模组方块补充物理属性标签。 |
| Sable Beyond | 扩展移动结构行为与兼容支持。 |

***

## 自动修复

AttributeFix 修复属性限制，Neo Bee Fix 修复蜜蜂行为。这些属于后台修复，不是管理员工具或制作系统。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| AttributeFix | 移除任意属性上限，支持模组兼容。 |
| Neo Bee Fix | 修复原版蜜蜂行为。 |

***

## 功能兼容

声音与动画兼容组件列在它们实际改变的功能页面，共享框架保留在支持库页面。

***

## 相关页面

technical.libraries.en_us:
## Aquatic & Create support

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Hybrid API | Shared framework required by Hybrid Aquatic. |
| Azimuth | Extends Create systems for addons such as More Girder. |
| Strut Your Stuff | Girder-strut library used by Create addons such as Bits 'n' Bobs. It has no independent item catalog. |

Use the parent content mod's recipes and Ponder entries. These dependencies do not require a separate survival setup.

***

## Loaders & languages

These components supply shared interfaces or language support. Connector supports selected Fabric mods on NeoForge, not every Fabric release.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sinytra Connector | Compatibility layer for selected Fabric mods on NeoForge. |
| Forgified Fabric API | Fabric interfaces implemented on NeoForge. |
| Architectury API | Shared cross-loader development interfaces. |
| Balm | Cross-loader abstraction library. |
| GroovyModLoader (GML) | Groovy language provider. |
| Kotlin for Forge | Kotlin language provider and utilities. |

***

## Configuration

These libraries provide settings, validation or settings-screen construction for other mods. They are not independent gameplay activities.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Cloth Config API | Configuration screen library. |
| Fzzy Config | Configuration, validation and synchronization support. |
| MidnightLib | Lightweight configuration system. |
| Prickle | Configuration file support. |
| Resourceful Config | Cross-platform configuration support. |
| YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) | Configuration screen construction library. |
| Apollib | Shared configuration and registry utilities. |

***

## Models & animation

These frameworks support animation, armor models and connected textures used by other content. A framework alone does not add a complete animated resource pack.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Armor Model API | Renders custom armor geometry through the vanilla armor pipeline. |
| Geckolib | Animation library for entities, blocks, items and armor. |
| Lionfish-API | Animation framework. |
| playerAnimator | Player animation library. |
| EMF Compat: Core | Shared framework for EMF compatibility modules. |
| Athena | Connected-texture framework. |

***

## World & structures

These components support world generation or moving structures. Use the gameplay pages for destinations and vehicle components.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Lithostitched | World-generation configuration and compatibility support. |
| Structure Pool API | Structure pool injection support. |
| YUNG's API | Shared code for YUNG's mods. |
| Sable | Framework for interactive moving block structures. |

***

## Combat frameworks

These components supply shared spell, attribute, weapon and projectile systems. Class equipment and spell choices are documented separately.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| More RPG Library | Shared framework for the More RPG series. |
| Spell Engine | Data-driven spell framework. |
| Spell Power Attributes | Spell-related attributes, effects and enchantment support. |
| Ranged Weapon API | Bow and crossbow development support. |
| Shield API | Custom shield model support. |
| Ritchie's Projectile Library | Projectile development support. |

***

## Shared code

Other supporting libraries are listed below. Keep required dependencies with the mods that use them. A library name is not a promise of new blocks, recipes or encounters.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Almanac | Shared loader-independent code. |
| BaguetteLib | Death-handling and inventory-tracking support. |
| Bookshelf | Shared code library. |
| Bundle API | Item-tag-based bundle support. |
| Collective | Shared code for Serilum's mods. |
| CreativeCore | Shared core utilities. |
| DragonLib | Shared code for dependent mods. |
| Iceberg | Shared events and utilities. |
| JamLib | Cross-platform shared code. |
| Lodestone | Shared rendering and feature code for dependent mods. |
| MaFgLib | Shared code for Forge ports of masa's mods. |
| Moonlight Lib | Shared registration and dynamic content utilities. |
| MRU | Shared framework for dependent mods. |
| oωo (owo-lib) | General utilities, interfaces and configuration support. |
| Placebo | Shared foundation, not standalone gameplay content. |
| Puzzles Lib | Shared systems for Fuzss mods. |
| Resourceful Lib | Shared code library. |
| Searchables | Search, filtering and completion support for interfaces. |
| Sophisticated Core | Shared code for Sophisticated mods. |
| Teal Lib | Shared code library. |

***

***

## 加载器与语言

这些组件提供共享接口或语言支持。Connector 让选定的 Fabric 模组在 NeoForge 上运行，不代表支持所有 Fabric 版本。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Sinytra Connector | 让部分选定的 Fabric 模组在 NeoForge 上运行的兼容层。 |
| Forgified Fabric API | 在 NeoForge 上实现的 Fabric 接口。 |
| Architectury API | 共享跨加载器开发接口。 |
| Balm | 跨加载器抽象库。 |
| GroovyModLoader (GML) | Groovy 语言支持。 |
| Kotlin for Forge | Kotlin 语言支持与工具。 |

***

## 设置框架

这些库为其他模组提供设置、校验或设置界面构建，并不是独立玩法。

| MidnightLib | 轻量设置系统。 |

| Geckolib | 实体、方块、物品与盔甲动画库。 |
| Lionfish-API | 动画框架。 |
| playerAnimator | 玩家动画库。 |
| EMF Compat: Core | EMF 兼容组件共享框架。 |

## 世界与结构

这些组件支持世界生成或移动结构。目的地与载具部件见玩法页面。

reference.audio.en_us:
## Rain & footsteps

Cool Rain Reforged changes rain ambience on supported surfaces. Presence Footsteps changes footsteps according to the surface walked on. Their Sable addons belong here because they extend those sounds to moving structures.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Cool Rain Reforged | Adds rain sounds for particular block surfaces. |
| Presence Footsteps (NeoForge) | Adds surface-sensitive footstep sounds. |
| Sable: Cool Rain | Extends rain sounds to Sable moving structures and supported copycat materials. |
| Presence Footsteps x Sable (Aeronautics Compat) | Extends Presence Footsteps to Sable moving structures. |

***

## Sound effects

Sounds adds interaction and interface sounds. More Sounds extends its content and mod compatibility. These do not replace the footstep and rain compatibility roles above.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sounds | Adds sounds for interfaces, items, blocks and other interactions. |
| More Sounds | Adds sound content and mod compatibility to Sounds. |

***

## Acoustics & volume

Sound Physics Remastered changes how sound travels through the surroundings. Extreme sound muffler quiets selected sounds on your client. Muting a machine sound does not stop the machine or change its processing.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sound Physics Remastered | Adds sound attenuation, reverberation and absorption through blocks. |
| Extreme sound muffler | Lets the client selectively quiet unwanted sounds. |

***

## Related topics

- [Moving structures](vehicles.assembly.md)
reference.audio.zh_cn:
## 雨声与脚步声

Cool Rain Reforged 改变受支持表面的雨声，Presence Footsteps 根据踩踏表面改变脚步声。它们的 Sable 附加组件属于声音功能，因为它们将相关声音扩展到移动结构。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Cool Rain Reforged | 为特定方块表面增加雨声。 |
| Presence Footsteps (NeoForge) | 增加随踩踏表面变化的脚步声。 |
| Sable: Cool Rain | 将雨声扩展到 Sable 移动结构与受支持的伪装材质。 |
| Presence Footsteps x Sable (Aeronautics Compat) | 让 Presence Footsteps 适配 Sable 移动结构。 |

***

## 交互音效

Sounds 增加交互与界面音效，More Sounds 扩展其内容和模组兼容。它们与上方脚步声及雨声兼容组件的作用不同。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Sounds | 为界面、物品、方块及其他交互增加音效。 |
| More Sounds | 为 Sounds 增加声音内容与模组兼容。 |

***

## 声学与音量

Sound Physics Remastered 改变声音在环境中的传播方式。Extreme sound muffler 在客户端降低选定声音。静音机器不会停止机器，也不会改变其处理过程。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Sound Physics Remastered | 增加声音衰减、混响与方块吸音。 |
| Extreme sound muffler | 允许客户端选择性降低不想听到的声音。 |

***

## 相关页面

- [移动结构](vehicles.assembly.md)

Custom animated pillager model

EMF Compat: Create adapts Create animations for animated player models. Its shared framework is listed under Libraries.

| Component | Function |

The heavy edition adds eating, block-interaction, third-person action and hostile-spawn animations. Enable compatible resource packs for custom animated models.

| Component | Function |

## 模型支持

![自定义掠夺者动画模型](images/feedback-entity-models.png)

自定义掠夺者动画模型

Entity Model Features 与 Entity Texture Features 提供自定义模型与纹理支持。Model Gap Fix 修复可见模型缝隙。自定义动画外观也取决于已启用资源包。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [EMF] Entity Model Features | 加载兼容资源包中的自定义实体模型。 |
| [ETF] Entity Texture Features | 支持随机、自定义与发光实体纹理。 |
| Model Gap Fix | 修复方块与物品模型的缝隙。 |

***

## 动画兼容

EMF Compat: Create 使机械动力动画适配动态玩家模型，其共享框架列在支持库页面。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| EMF Compat: Create | 使机械动力玩家动画适配自定义动态模型。 |

***

## 动作与生成动画

重型版增加进食、方块交互、第三人称动作与敌对生物生成动画。自定义动态模型需要启用兼容资源包。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Eating Animations（仅重型版） | 增加进食动画。 |

space.vehicle-transfer.en_us:
## Launch vehicle

![Spacecraft above Earth](images/feedback-earth-orbit.png)

Spacecraft above Earth

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:booster_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:thruster_mount" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rcs_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:fluid_hose" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:titanium_ingot" /></ItemGrid>

An orbital ship is a Simulated Contraption with a rocket engine, a fuel feed and a thrust mount. Build the hull as described in [Assembly](vehicles.assembly.md), then fit the engine.

| Part | Job |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /> | Main thrust, burns liquid fuel |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:booster_thruster" /> | Extra thrust for the first climb |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:thruster_mount" /> | Holds the engine to the hull |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rcs_thruster" /> | Small corrections once in vacuum |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:fluid_hose" /> | Carries fuel from tank to engine |

The engine burns fuel, not rotation. Feed it through the ship's fluid system and keep the tank above the engine feed, because a dry feed gives no thrust even with a full tank elsewhere.

## Crossing into Deep Space

The pack puts the transfer at height 20,000. Climb above it and the ship, plus the passengers aboard, moves into Deep Space. That is a world height, not a height above the launch pad, so a base on a mountain starts the count higher.

| Height | What changes | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7,000 | Drag has fallen to zero | Stop relying on propellers |
| 20,000 | Transfer height into Deep Space | Cross it with fuel left for the return |
| 21,000 | Low density air and drowning | Have a sealed helmet and air supply aboard |

The crew needs that air supply before the crossing, as covered in [Space life support](space.life-support.md).

A change in sky colour is not a transfer. Check the world height and the dimension name, not the view.

## Arriving

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rcs_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:velocity_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_crafter" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

Approach the linked body in Deep Space and cross the same transfer height inward. The ship arrives high above that surface, not landed and not on autopilot, so plan the descent before you cross.

1. Cut thrust early and let gravity do the work.
2. Keep some fuel for the landing burn, because the return trip needs the same crossing.
3. Watch the altitude sensor and the velocity sensor rather than the view, since the ground arrives fast in low gravity.
4. Land on flat ground. A hull that touches down on a slope slides before it settles.

The Moon's surface acceleration is 2.0 against the Overworld's 11.0, so the same descent that lands gently at home overshoots there. Reduce the descent burn, not the approach speed alone.

The return is the same crossing in reverse. Climb back above 20,000, cross into Deep Space, approach the Overworld and descend. Carry enough fuel for both crossings, because there is no fuel depot on the Moon unless you build one.
space.vehicle-transfer.zh_cn:
## 运载火箭

![地球轨道上的飞船](images/feedback-earth-orbit.png)

地球轨道上的飞船

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:booster_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:thruster_mount" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rcs_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:fluid_hose" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:titanium_ingot" /></ItemGrid>

轨道飞船是装有火箭发动机、燃料供给与推力座的模拟悬浮体。按[组装](vehicles.assembly.md)造好船体，再装发动机。

| 部件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /> | 主推力，燃烧液体燃料 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:booster_thruster" /> | 首段爬升的额外推力 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:thruster_mount" /> | 把发动机固定在船体上 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rcs_thruster" /> | 进入真空后的微调 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:fluid_hose" /> | 把燃料从储罐送到发动机 |

发动机烧的是燃料，不是旋转力。通过船体流体系统供油，并让储罐高于发动机进油口，因为进油口干了就没有推力，储罐再满也没用。

## 越入深空

本包把转移高度设在 20000。爬升越过这个高度，飞船与船上乘客一起进入深空。这是世界高度，不是离发射台的高度，所以建在山上的基地起点更高。

| 高度 | 变化 | 应对 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7000 | 阻力降为零 | 不要再依赖螺旋桨 |
| 20000 | 进入深空的转移高度 | 越界时留好返程燃料 |
| 21000 | 低密度空气与溺水 | 船上备好密闭头盔与空气供给 |

越界之前就要备好空气供给，详见[太空生命维持](space.life-support.md)。

天空颜色变化不代表已经转移。看世界高度与维度名称，不要看风景。

## 抵达

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rcs_thruster" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:altitude_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="simulated:velocity_sensor" /><ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_crafter" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /></ItemGrid>

在深空中接近已连接的天体，向内越过同一个转移高度。飞船会出现在该地表上方很高的位置，既没有着陆，也没有自动驾驶，所以越界之前先计划下降。

1. 提前收油，让重力完成剩下的工作。
2. 留一部分燃料给着陆点火，返程还要再越一次高度。
3. 看高度传感器与速度传感器，不要看风景，低重力下地面来得很快。
4. 在平地着陆。落在斜坡上的船体会先滑动再停下。

月球表面加速度是 2.0，主世界是 11.0，在家门口能轻着陆的同一套下降，在那里会冲过头。要减的是下降点火力度，不只是接近速度。

返程就是反向越界。重新爬升到 20000 以上，进入深空，接近主世界再下降。两次越界都要留够燃料，因为月球上没有加油站，除非你自己建一座。

## Recover equipment

![A corpse holding dropped equipment](images/visual-corpse-recovery.png)

A corpse holding dropped equipment

Corpse leaves a body at your death location containing your carried items. Return to that location and interact with the body to open its inventory. Recovering items still requires reaching the site safely, prepare replacement equipment before returning to a dangerous encounter.

Corpse x Curios compatibility restores supported accessories to their equipment slots when transferring them. Check your slots after recovery rather than assuming every accessory is equipped.

***

## Death history

The death-history interface records earlier deaths. Find its binding in Controls if another action uses the same key. History is a reference for recovery, it does not grant free survival-mode item retrieval or teleportation. Administrative and creative recovery features have separate permissions.

Access restrictions and corpse expiry can depend on server settings. Do not treat a body as permanent storage.

***

- [Maps](maps.personal.md) Navigation and waypoints.

## Rest while travelling

Sleeping bags provide portable night-time rest without changing your home respawn point. The pack enables their recipes. This white example uses three white wool blocks, other colors use their matching wool.

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="comforts:sleeping_bag_white" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="comforts:sleeping_bag_white" />

<Recipe id="comforts:sleeping_bag_white" />

***

## Hammocks & time

Hammocks provide daytime rest that turns day into night, without changing your respawn point. The pack allows hammocks during the day and sleeping bags at night, server settings can change those rules.

Better Days controls day and night duration and can accelerate time while players sleep. The server determines its active time settings, installing the mod does not imply a particular day length or that every processing machine accelerates with sleep.

***

## Related topics

- [Browse recipe](help.search.md) Hammock parts and other sleeping-bag colors.
- [Recovery](adventure.recovery.md) Returning after death.

## 旅途中休息

睡袋便于夜间在外休息，不会改变家中的重生点。整合包启用了睡袋配方。这里的白色睡袋使用三块白色羊毛，其他颜色使用对应颜色的羊毛。

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="comforts:sleeping_bag_white" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="comforts:sleeping_bag_white" />

<Recipe id="comforts:sleeping_bag_white" />

***

## 吊床与时间

吊床用于白天休息，将白天转为夜晚，同样不会改变重生点。整合包允许白天使用吊床、夜晚使用睡袋，服务器可以更改这些规则。

Better Days 控制昼夜时长，也可以在玩家睡眠时加速时间。具体时间设置由服务器决定，安装模组不代表一天必定有某种长度，也不代表睡眠会让所有加工机器加速。

***

## 相关主题

- [浏览配方](help.search.md) 吊床部件与其他颜色的睡袋。
- [取回物品](adventure.recovery.md) 死亡后返回现场。

index.en_us:
![Steampunk Airship by Merun173](images/home-astropunk-title.png)

Build an airship, choose your combat class and take on a world that grows more dangerous as you play. Astropunk is a survival sandbox where your workshop, your home and your adventures all have room to grow.

Explore dungeons and fight bosses with weapons, spells and trinkets that suit your build. Develop your skills, then return home to tend crops, cook, decorate or automate the work with Create machinery. Build a quiet farm or a busy factory, sail the seas or take to the sky.

There is no quest chain telling you what to do next. The sidebar gives you quick entry points into each topic. Choose what interests you and make it your own.

- [Credits](help.credits.md)
index.zh_cn:
![Merun173 建造的蒸汽朋克飞艇](images/home-astropunk-title.png)

建造飞艇，选择战斗职业，挑战一个随时间推移变得更加危险的世界。Astropunk 是自由发展的生存沙盒，你可以经营工坊与家园，也可以带上装备出门探险。

探索地牢，用适合自己战斗风格的武器、法术与饰品挑战首领，再通过技能培养自己的长处。回到家中，你可以耕种、烹饪、装饰，或用 Create 机械把劳作自动化。建一座安静的农场，经营繁忙的工厂，扬帆出海，或驾驶飞艇升空。

这里没有规定下一步目标的任务链。侧栏提供各个主题的快捷入口，选择你感兴趣的玩法，按自己的想法发展。

- [鸣谢](help.credits.md)

combat.abilities.en_us:
## Prepare a class book

![Spell books and the Spell Binding Table](images/visual-spell-binding.png)

<EmiSearch query="@spell_engine" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

A weapon's built-in ability is separate from the spells a class book teaches.

1. Put a normal <ItemLink id="minecraft:book" /> in the table, select the matching class book and pay the displayed experience levels. Witcher offers separate Fencing and Signs books.
2. Put the class book back with <ItemLink id="minecraft:lapis_lazuli" /> and pick abilities that meet the shown level, lapis cost and bookshelf power. Add valid nearby <ItemLink id="minecraft:bookshelf" /> when power is short, and watch for tier conflicts or the book's slot limit.
3. Equip the configured book in its spell-book slot and hold a compatible weapon or focus. The held item filters which spells you can use.

Class books are configured versions of <ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_book" />, not separate craftable items. A <ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /> carries one spell, so read the next section before spending it.

***

## Use a spell scroll

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

A scroll uses a single spell found as loot or adds it to a compatible book, and it is not a universal unlock for every class.

- To try its spell alone, equip the scroll in the supported spell-book slot instead of your book and hold a compatible weapon. A separate scroll slot only works if it is enabled, so do not assume every accessory slot accepts one.
- To keep the spell, put the receiving class book in the table's book slot and the scroll in the material slot instead of lapis. Select the offered spell and confirm that the book's pool accepts it before applying.
- If no offer appears, check that the spell belongs to that pool, then inspect existing spells, tier conflicts and remaining capacity. More ordinary experience cannot fix an incompatible book.

Applying the offered spell consumes the scroll and charges the displayed experience-level cost. This transfer does not require lapis. Use the table's current offer rather than assuming scroll binding costs the same as learning with lapis.

***

## Cast an ability

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid>

Read its tooltip for school, target, casting time, resource cost and cooldown, and keep required ammunition or runes ready. A learned spell can stay unavailable with an incompatible weapon, and the casting bar shows a cast still in progress.

The first spell action is set in Key Binds, currently <KeyBind id="keybindings.spell_engine.spell_hotbar_1" />, and you can change it there when it shows as unbound.

- [Magic & support](combat.magic.md) Weapon spells, songs, rune types and pouch crafting.
- [Combat controls](combat.handling.md) Attacks, rolls and control conflicts.

***

## Gear & skill points

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="skill_tree_rpgs:orb_of_oblivion" /></ItemGrid>

Match the ability's attribute to your equipment. Fire power strengthens Fire spells and not Frost spells, and healing uses healing power. Melee and ranged techniques can use different attributes even within one class. Armor protection and school bonuses do different jobs, and relic triggers are not freely castable class spells.

Binding spends ordinary experience levels. Class points and weapon points develop their own connected trees and do not replace binding, and changing equipment does not refund points.

- [Character skills](combat.skills.md) Open with <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" />, read incompatible roots and check resets.
- [Weapons & armor](equipment.weapons-armor.md) Class equipment and shared named sets.
- [Accessories](equipment.accessories.md) Jewelry, relics and accepted slots.

***

## Starter focuses

The Novice Wand is a low-cost Fire starting point, not an Arcane or Frost substitute. The Acolyte Wand starts healing with sticks and string. Other starters and complete ability inventories belong to their class articles.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_novice" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<Recipe id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:acolyte_wand" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

<Recipe id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

- [Martial classes](combat.martial.md) Ranged and melee class articles.
- [Magic & support classes](combat.magic.md) Magic and support class articles.

***

## When an ability does not work

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" /></ItemGrid>

| Symptom | Check first |
| --- | --- |
| Spell missing from the hotbar | Is the book equipped, does it hold the spell, and does the held weapon allow it? |
| Action shows but will not cast | Runes or ammunition, cooldown, target and range, then the key binding. |
| Damage or healing feels low | The ability's attribute against the held weapon and armor. A higher armor value is not spell power. |

Change one thing, then repeat a low-risk cast. A working setup shows the intended ability and produces its described attack, healing or protection effect.

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+spell+binding+table+spell+book+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+%E6%B3%95%E6%9C%AF%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%B0+%E8%81%8C%E4%B8%9A%E4%B9%A6+%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)
combat.abilities.zh_cn:
## 准备职业书

![法术书与法术绑定台](images/visual-spell-binding.png)

<EmiSearch query="@spell_engine" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

武器自带招式与职业书教授的招式是两回事。

1. 将普通 <ItemLink id="minecraft:book" /> 放入绑定台，选择对应职业书并支付显示的经验等级。猎魔人有独立的剑术书与法印书。
2. 将职业书放回绑定台并放入 <ItemLink id="minecraft:lapis_lazuli" />，选择满足等级、青金石消耗与书架能量的招式。能量不足时在附近添加有效的 <ItemLink id="minecraft:bookshelf" />，并留意同阶冲突与书籍槽位上限。
3. 将配置好的书放入法术书槽，并手持兼容武器或法器。手持物品会筛选可用法术。

职业书是 <ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_book" /> 的配置变体，并非独立的合成物品。<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /> 只携带一个法术，使用前先看下一节。

***

## 使用法术卷轴

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

卷轴可让你使用战利品中的单个法术，或把它加入兼容书籍，但它不能通用于所有职业。

- 想单独试用时，把卷轴放入支持的法术书槽暂时代替职业书，再手持兼容武器。独立卷轴槽只有启用后才能使用，并非所有饰品槽都接受卷轴。
- 想保存在书中，把接收法术的职业书放入绑定台的书籍槽，用卷轴代替青金石放入材料槽。选择显示的法术，并确认书籍池接受该法术后再应用。
- 若没有可用选项，先确认该法术属于这本书的法术池，再检查已学招式、同阶冲突与剩余容量。书籍不兼容时，积攒更多普通经验也不能解决。

应用所选法术会消耗卷轴，并扣除界面显示的普通经验等级。这种转移不需要青金石。以绑定台当前显示为准，不要假设卷轴绑定与青金石学习消耗相同。

***

## 释放招式

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid>

查看提示中的学派、目标、施法时间、材料消耗与冷却，并备好所需弹药或符文。已学法术仍可能因武器不兼容而无法使用，施法条显示施法是否仍在进行。

第一个招式在按键设置中配置，当前为 <KeyBind id="keybindings.spell_engine.spell_hotbar_1" />，显示未绑定时可在那里修改。

- [魔法与辅助](combat.magic.md) 武器法术、乐曲、符文种类与符文袋制作。
- [战斗操作](combat.handling.md) 攻击、翻滚与按键冲突。

***

## 装备与技能点

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="skill_tree_rpgs:orb_of_oblivion" /></ItemGrid>

让装备契合招式使用的属性。火焰强度增强火系法术，不增强冰霜法术，治疗则使用治疗强度。同一职业的近战与远程招式也可能使用不同属性。护甲防护与学派加成作用不同，遗物触发效果也不是可任意释放的职业法术。

绑定消耗普通经验等级。职业点数与武器点数用于各自相连的技能树，不能代替绑定，更换装备也不会返还点数。

- [技能成长](combat.skills.md) 按 <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> 打开界面，查看互斥根节点与重置。
- [武器与护甲](equipment.weapons-armor.md) 职业装备与通用具名套装。
- [饰品](equipment.accessories.md) 珠宝、遗物与适用槽位。

***

## 入门法器

新手魔杖是低成本火系起点，不能代替奥术或冰霜法器。侍僧魔杖以木棍与线开始治疗路线。其他入门装备与完整招式目录见各职业文章。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_novice" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<Recipe id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:acolyte_wand" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

<Recipe id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

- [武技职业](combat.martial.md) 远程与近战职业文章。
- [法术与支援职业](combat.magic.md) 魔法与辅助职业文章。

***

## 招式无效时

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" /></ItemGrid>

| 现象 | 优先检查 |
| --- | --- |
| 法术没有出现在快捷栏 | 是否装备了配置好的书，书中是否已有该法术，手持武器是否允许使用？ |
| 招式出现却不能释放 | 先检查符文或弹药、冷却、有效目标与距离，再看当前按键。 |
| 开始施法却没有命中 | 蓄力或引导时间、目标条件与视线。 |
| 伤害或治疗效果偏低 | 核对该招式的属性，再比较手持武器与护甲。护甲值更高不代表法术强度更高。 |

每次只调整一项，再安全试放。能看到预期招式，并产生说明中的攻击、治疗或防护效果，才算配置成功。

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+spell+binding+table+spell+book+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+%E6%B3%95%E6%9C%AF%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%B0+%E8%81%8C%E4%B8%9A%E4%B9%A6+%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

space.life-support.en_us:
## Breathing kit

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:copper_diving_helmet" /><ItemIcon id="create:copper_backtank" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /><ItemIcon id="create:netherite_backtank" /></ItemGrid>

Space in this pack has no breathable air above the atmosphere. Two pieces solve it, a sealed helmet and a pressurised air supply.

| Piece | Slot | Supplies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:copper_diving_helmet" /> | Head | Lets you breathe from a connected air source |
| <ItemLink id="create:copper_backtank" /> | Chest | Stored air, charged before flight |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /> | Head | Breathing from a pressurised source, plus an orbital display |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /> | Chest | Pressurised air and personal thrust |

A Copper Diving Helmet with a charged Copper Backtank is the cheapest working pair, and both have recipes. The Space Helmet has no crafting recipe in this pack, so treat it as found equipment rather than a step you can plan around.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_diving_helmet" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_backtank" />

## Jetpack

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/jetpack" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="create:spout" /></ItemGrid>

The <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /> burns Fuel. Alternate-click it with a Lava Bucket to refill, or fill it at a <ItemLink id="create:spout" />. Press <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_jetpack" /> to toggle the systems, and hold jump for a short burst of vertical thrust.

Worn, it also supplies pressurised air to equipment that needs it, and it drains Fuel slowly while doing so. That drain continues whether or not you have flight toggled on, so a long stay in vacuum empties the tank even if you never thrust.

## Sealed rooms

![Gravity equipment in a ship compartment](images/cosmo-gravity-room.png)

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /><ItemIcon id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" /></ItemGrid>

A ship can carry its own air. Build an intact sealed compartment inside the hull, then supply it.

| Machine | Needs | Gives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /> | Water and Forge Energy, or a shaft in its module slot | Oxygen |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /> | Oxygen in its tank and a redstone signal | Breathable air in the sealed room |
| <ItemLink id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" /> | Forge Energy and a neighbouring redstone signal | Local gravity in the room |

Deep Air restores breathing inside an oxygenated compartment while the ship is unbreached. It does not seal the hull and it does not make oxygen, so a breach ends the effect no matter how much oxygen is stored. The diffuser consumes oxygen in proportion to the compartment size, which is why a small cabin is easier to keep supplied than a whole deck.

The gravity generator is a separate room function. It does not need a diffuser in the same room, but keep at least one room oxygenated so the compartment tracking stays valid.

<Recipe id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:oxygen_diffuser" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />
## Personal movement

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:copper_leg_thrusters" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:copper_anchor_boots" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:copper_leg_thrusters" /> give flight and inertial dampeners from pressurised air, and they are four times as efficient in space as on the ground and twice as efficient underwater. Toggle the dampeners with <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_dampeners" />.

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:copper_anchor_boots" /> hold you to a supporting floor except while you are actively flying. They do not create gravity for anyone else and they do not work in open air.

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/copper_leg_thrusters" />

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/copper_anchor_boots" />
space.life-support.zh_cn:
## 呼吸装备

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create:copper_diving_helmet" /><ItemIcon id="create:copper_backtank" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /><ItemIcon id="create:netherite_backtank" /></ItemGrid>

本包在大气层以上没有可呼吸空气。两件东西可以解决，一件密闭头盔和一份加压空气。

| 部件 | 槽位 | 提供 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create:copper_diving_helmet" /> | 头部 | 从连接的空气源呼吸 |
| <ItemLink id="create:copper_backtank" /> | 胸部 | 储存空气，飞行前充满 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /> | 头部 | 从加压源呼吸，并带轨道显示 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /> | 胸部 | 加压空气与个人推力 |

铜潜水头盔配充满的铜背罐是最便宜可用的组合，两者都有配方。太空头盔在本包没有合成配方，只能当作拾取到的装备，而不是可以规划的步骤。

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_diving_helmet" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_backtank" />
## 喷气背包

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/jetpack" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /><ItemIcon id="create:spout" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /> 燃烧燃料。手持熔岩桶按住替代键点击可以补充，也可以在 <ItemLink id="create:spout" /> 处灌装。按 <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_jetpack" /> 切换系统，按住跳跃可以短促向上推进。

穿在身上时，它还会向需要加压空气的装备供气，同时缓慢消耗燃料。这项消耗与飞行开关无关，所以在真空里久留会慢慢耗尽燃料，即使一次也没推进。

## 密闭舱室

![船舱内的重力设备](images/cosmo-gravity-room.png)

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /><ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /><ItemIcon id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" /></ItemGrid>

船可以自带空气。在船体内部造一个完整的密闭舱，然后给它供气。

| 机器 | 需要 | 提供 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /> | 水与 Forge 能量，或模块槽中的传动轴 | 氧气 |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /> | 罐中氧气与红石信号 | 密闭舱内的可呼吸空气 |
| <ItemLink id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" /> | Forge 能量与相邻红石信号 | 舱内局部重力 |

Deep Air 在舱室供氧且船体未破损时恢复呼吸。它不封住船体，也不制氧，所以一旦破口，效果就结束，储存多少氧气都没用。扩散器按舱室体积消耗氧气，这就是小舱比整层甲板更容易维持的原因。

重力发生器是另一项舱室功能。它与扩散器不必在同一舱，但至少要让一个舱保持供氧，舱室追踪才继续有效。

<Recipe id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:oxygen_diffuser" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

space.navigation.en_us:
## Planetary display

![Hologram planetary display](images/cosmo-hologram.png)

Hologram planetary display

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" /> draws the system you are in. Short-click its configuration points to change the scale, and read the body you are aiming for before you burn fuel.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:sputnik" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /></ItemGrid>

The display is a model, not a destination selector. Selecting a body on it does not steer the ship and does not open a transfer.

What the pack actually uses is the transfer height. The Overworld and the Moon both send a body to Deep Space at height 20,000, and the same height is where a descent from Deep Space comes back in. Aim for a body, cross the height, and you have moved.

## Bodies and gravity

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />

The system data in this pack gives each body a surface acceleration. The Overworld is 11.0 and the Moon is 2.0, so a lander tuned for the Overworld falls faster than it expects on the Moon. A ship that hovers easily at home will climb faster and brake later there.

| Body | Surface acceleration | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Overworld | 11.0 | Starting point, thick air |
| Moon | 2.0 | Low gravity, no thick air |
| Mars, gas giant, ice world | Listed in the display | Check before you commit |

Air also thins with height. Above 21,000 the pack marks the atmosphere as low density and applies drowning, so a crew without a sealed helmet and air supply stops breathing long before the crossing. Drag falls to zero by 7,000, which is why a propeller stops helping in the upper atmosphere and a rocket takes over.

## Probe and helmet

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:sputnik" /> keeps chunks loaded and reports biome colours for mapping. It is a survey tool, not a pilot, and it does not fly a route for you.

In Deep Space the Space Helmet shows an orbital display. <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_alignment" /> toggles the alignment helper. That changes what you see, not where the ship points.

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />

## Reading a trip before launch

| Check | Why it decides the trip |
| --- | --- |
| Surface acceleration of the target | Sets how fast you fall and how much braking thrust you need |
| Helmet and charged air supply | Above 21,000 the air stops supporting breathing |
| Thrust that works without air | A propeller loses its medium by 7,000 |
| Assembled hull and running fuel feed | An unassembled build has no physics and a dry feed makes no thrust |
space.navigation.zh_cn:
## 行星显示

![全息行星显示](images/cosmo-hologram.png)

全息行星显示

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" /> 绘制所在星系。短按它的配置点可以改变比例，在消耗燃料之前先看清目标天体。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:sputnik" /><ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:space_helmet" /></ItemGrid>

显示只是模型，不是目的地选择器。在它上面选中天体不会操控飞船，也不会开启转移。

本包真正使用的是转移高度。主世界与月球都在高度 20000 把载体送入深空，从深空返回也在这个高度进入。对准天体，越过高度，就完成了移动。

## 天体与重力

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:hologram_block" />

本包的星系数据给每个天体设定了表面加速度。主世界是 11.0，月球是 2.0，所以按主世界调好的着陆器在月球上会比预想落得更快。在家门口轻松悬停的船，到那里会爬升更快、制动更晚。

| 天体 | 表面加速度 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 主世界 | 11.0 | 起点，空气浓厚 |
| 月球 | 2.0 | 低重力，没有浓厚空气 |
| 火星、气态巨行星、冰世界 | 在显示中列出 | 出发前先确认 |

空气也随高度变稀。21000 以上本包把大气标记为低密度并施加溺水效果，所以没有密闭头盔与供气的船员在越界之前就无法呼吸。阻力到 7000 已经降为零，这就是螺旋桨在高空失效、必须换用火箭的原因。

## 探测器与头盔

<ItemLink id="rocketnautics:sputnik" /> 保持区块加载并报告生物群系颜色用于制图。它是勘测工具，不是驾驶员，也不会替你飞航线。

在深空中，太空头盔会显示轨道信息。按 <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_alignment" /> 切换对齐辅助。它改变你看到的内容，不改变船的朝向。

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:sputnik" />

## 出发前读一遍

| 检查项 | 为何决定这趟行程 |
| --- | --- |
| 目标天体的表面加速度 | 决定下落速度与所需制动力 |
| 头盔与充满的空气供给 | 21000 以上空气无法支持呼吸 |
| 无空气仍有效的推进 | 螺旋桨到 7000 就失去介质 |
| 已组装的船体与运行中的燃料供给 | 未组装的结构没有物理，断油则没有推力 |

## Fillets keep the rarity

Seafood cooking starts at the cutting board. A Starcatcher fish that belongs to a rarity tag cuts into one fillet of that rarity and one fish bone, so a fillet is an ingredient with a tier rather than a neutral portion.

| Tool | Identify it | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /></ItemGrid> | Holds the fish while you cut |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /></ItemGrid> | Cuts the fish into a fillet |

Place the board on a solid block. Use the fish on the board to place it, then hold the knife and use the board to cut it. A fillet and a bone drop beside the board.

| Rarity | Fillet | Identify it | What the tier decides |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Common | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_common" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_common" /></ItemGrid> | The common version of a shared dish |
| Uncommon | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_uncommon" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_uncommon" /></ItemGrid> | The uncommon version of a shared dish |
| Rare | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_rare" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_rare" /></ItemGrid> | The rare version of a shared dish |
| Epic | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_epic" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_epic" /></ItemGrid> | The epic version of a shared dish |
| Legendary | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_legendary" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_legendary" /></ItemGrid> | The legendary version, which also grants absorption hearts |

A legendary fillet cannot stand in for a common one, and a common fillet cannot make a legendary dish. Which waters hold which rarity belongs to the Starcatcher book.

- [Fishing](food.fishing.md) Rod, bait and the catch book.
- [Cooking tools](food.utensils.md) The board and knife interactions shared by every food topic.

## Hybrid Delights

<ItemLink id="hybrid_delights:lobster_stew" /> is the pot dish to aim for first. It takes raw lobster, a lobster tail, bread, an onion and a tomato, and it cooks in the same cooking pot as the sushi.

The mod also works from larger sea creatures. Cut a tuna at the board with a knife to get two fish steaks, plus a two in three chance of fish gelatin. Cutting cod gives two cod slices, bone meal, and a one in two chance of cod roe, so roe is a bonus rather than a guaranteed return.

## 鱼片保留稀有度

海鲜料理从砧板开始。属于某个稀有度标签的星钓鱼，会切成一片同稀有度的鱼片和一根鱼骨，所以鱼片是带等级的食材。

| 工具 | 图标 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:cutting_board" /></ItemGrid> | 放鱼并支撑切割 |
| <ItemLink id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="farmersdelight:flint_knife" /></ItemGrid> | 把鱼切成鱼片 |

把砧板放在结实的方块上。对着砧板使用鱼，把鱼放上去，再手持刀对着砧板使用，把它切开。鱼片和鱼骨会落在砧板旁。

| 稀有度 | 鱼片 | 图标 | 等级决定什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 普通 | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_common" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_common" /></ItemGrid> | 通用菜品的普通版本 |
| 罕见 | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_uncommon" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_uncommon" /></ItemGrid> | 通用菜品的罕见版本 |
| 稀有 | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_rare" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_rare" /></ItemGrid> | 通用菜品的稀有版本 |
| 史诗 | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_epic" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_epic" /></ItemGrid> | 通用菜品的史诗版本 |
| 传说 | <ItemLink id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_legendary" /> | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="starcatcher_delight:starcaught_fillet_legendary" /></ItemGrid> | 传说版本，还会给予伤害吸收生命 |

传说鱼片替代不了普通鱼片，普通鱼片也做不出传说菜品。哪片水域出哪种稀有度，是星钓图鉴负责的内容。

守卫者的肉块来自海底神殿战斗，不来自钓竿。鱿鱼与海洋植物是不用进结构就能收集的部分。

## Other encounters

Great White Sharks also have shipwreck encounter definitions. A beached shipwreck is not evidence that a shark can survive on dry land. Not every named entity is ordinary wildlife. Goldfish, Hagfish, Nautilus, Pearlfish, Umbrella Octopus, Vampire Squid, Beakling, Shell Beast, Karcinogen, Karcinoma and Karkinos have no ordinary biome-spawn entry in this catalog. Their separate acquisition or encounter conditions are not confirmed here.

***
